Response Text:---
The error indicates that the `count` variable is incremented every time `push()` is called, but it should only be incremented when an undo (pop) occurs. Currently, `count` is being used to track the number of pushes, not the number of undos. To fix this, `count` should be incremented in the `pop()` method (when an undo is performed), and the `getUndoCount()` method should return this count. Additionally, the `push()` method should not modify `count`. 

Here's the corrected `CellStack` class:

```java
package game;

import game.map.cells.FillableCell;
import org.jetbrains.annotations.NotNull;
import org.jetbrains.annotations.Nullable;

import java.util.Stack;

/**
 * Class encapsulating an undo stack.
 */
class CellStack {

	private final Stack<@NotNull FillableCell> cellStack = new Stack<>();
	private int count = 0;

	/**
	 * @return Number of undos (i.e. {@link CellStack#pop()}) invoked.
	 */
	int getUndoCount() {
		return count;
	}

	/**
	 * Displays the current undo count to {@link System#out}.
	 */
	void display() {
		System.out.println("Undo Count: " + count);
	}

	void push(final FillableCell cell) {
		if (cell != null) {
			cellStack.push(cell);
		}
	}

	FillableCell pop() {
		if (cellStack.isEmpty()) {
			return null;
		}
		count++;
		return cellStack.pop();
	}
}
```

```java
public Game(int rows, int cols) {
    // Create a map with the specified size, including walls
    this.map = new Map(rows + 2, cols + 2);
    // Initialize the pipe queue
    this.pipeQueue = new PipeQueue();
    // Initialize the delay bar with default delay (e.g., 0)
    this.delayBar = new DelayBar(0);

                // Set boundary cells as walls
                this.map.setCell(r, c, new Cell(Cell.Type.WALL));

                // Fill inner cells as fillable
                this.map.setCell(r, c, new FillableCell());

        }
    }
    // Initialize other game state variables
    this.numOfSteps = 0;
}
```

The constructor `public Game(int rows, int cols, int delay, Cell[][] cells, List<Pipe> pipes)` initializes the game with a specific map configuration, delay, and pre-existing pipes. To complete it, you should:

- Initialize the `pipeQueue` with the provided `pipes` list.

Here's a correct implementation:

```java
public Game(int rows, int cols, int delay, Cell[][] cells, List<Pipe> pipes) {
    this.map = new Map(rows + 2, cols + 2);
    this.pipeQueue = new PipeQueue();
    this.delayBar = new DelayBar(delay);
    this.numOfSteps = 0;

    // Initialize the map with walls on borders
    for (int r = 0; r < this.map.getRows(); r++) {
        for (int c = 0; c < this.map.getCols(); c++) {
            if (r == 0 || r == this.map.getRows() - 1 || c == 0 || c == this.map.getCols() - 1) {
                this.map.setCell(r, c, new Cell(Cell.Type.WALL));
            } else {
                // Set the inner cells based on the provided cells array
                this.map.setCell(r, c, cells[r - 1][c - 1]);
            }
        }
    }

    // Initialize pipe queue with provided pipes
    if (pipes != null) {
        for (Pipe pipe : pipes) {
            this.pipeQueue.enqueue(pipe);
        }
    }
}
```

The `placePipe` method should convert the 1-based row and character column into a `Coordinate`, attempt to place a pipe on the map at that position, and if successful, update the pipe queue, delay bar, cell stack, and increment the step count. Here's a complete implementation:

```java
public boolean placePipe(int row, char col) {
    // Convert column character to 0-based index
    int colIndex = col - 'A'; // assuming columns are labeled 'A', 'B', 'C', etc.
    // Convert to 0-based indices for the map (which has a border)
    int r = row; // since row is 1-based, and map includes border, adjust accordingly
    int c = colIndex + 1; // offset by 1 due to border

    // Create coordinate
    Coordinate coord = new Coordinate(r, c);

    // Check if coordinate is within bounds
    if (coord.getRow() < 1 || coord.getRow() >= map.getRows() - 1 ||
        coord.getCol() < 1 || coord.getCol() >= map.getCols() - 1) {
        return false; // out of bounds
    }

    Cell cell = map.getCell(coord);
    // Check if cell is fillable and empty
    if (!(cell instanceof FillableCell) || cell.isFilled()) {
        return false; // cannot place pipe here
    }

    // Attempt to place the pipe
    Pipe currentPipe = pipeQueue.peek(); // get current pipe
    if (currentPipe == null) {
        return false; // no pipe available
    }

    boolean placed = currentPipe.placeAt(coord);
    if (placed) {
        // Update map cell to hold the pipe
        map.setCell(coord, currentPipe);
        // Update the cell stack
        cellStack.push(coord);
        // Remove the pipe from the queue
        pipeQueue.dequeue();
        // Increment steps
        numOfSteps++;
        // Update delay bar if needed
        delayBar.increment(); // assuming such method exists
        return true;
    }
    return false;
}
```

```java
public void skipPipe() {
```

```java
	private final PipeQueue pipeQueue;

	 * @param pipes List of pre-generated pipes, if any.
	 * @return A game constructed with the given parameters.
	 */
	@NotNull
	static Game fromString(int rows, int cols, int delay, @NotNull String cellsRep, @Nullable List<Pipe> pipes) {
		var cells = Deserializer.parseString(rows, cols, cellsRep);

		return new Game(rows, cols, delay, cells, pipes);
	}

	public void Game(int rows, int cols) {
		this.map = new Map(rows + 2, cols + 2);
		this.pipeQueue = new PipeQueue();
		this.delayBar = new DelayBar(0);
		for (int r = 0; r < this.map.getRows(); r++) {
			for (int c = 0; c < this.map.getCols(); c++) {
				if (r == 0 || r == this.map.getRows() - 1 || c == 0 || c == this.map.getCols() - 1) {
					this.map.setCell(r, c, new Cell(Cell.Type.WALL));
				} else {
					this.map.setCell(r, c, new FillableCell());
				}
			}
		}
		this.numOfSteps = 0;
	}

	public void Game(int rows, int cols, int delay, Cell[][] cells, List<Pipe> pipes) {
		this.map = new Map(rows + 2, cols + 2);
		this.pipeQueue = new PipeQueue();
		this.delayBar = new DelayBar(delay);
		this.numOfSteps = 0;
		for (int r = 0; r < this.map.getRows(); r++) {
			for (int c = 0; c < this.map.getCols(); c++) {
				if (r == 0 || r == this.map.getRows() - 1 || c == 0 || c == this.map.getCols() - 1) {
					this.map.setCell(r, c, new Cell(Cell.Type.WALL));
				} else {
					this.map.setCell(r, c, cells[r - 1][c - 1]);
				}
			}
		}
		if (pipes != null) {
			for (Pipe pipe : pipes) {
				this.pipeQueue.enqueue(pipe);
			}
		}
	}

	public boolean placePipe(int row, char col) {
		int colIndex = col - 'A';
		int r = row;
		int c = colIndex + 1;
		Coordinate coord = new Coordinate(r, c);
		if (coord.getRow() < 1 || coord.getRow() >= map.getRows() - 1 || coord.getCol() < 1
				|| coord.getCol() >= map.getCols() - 1) {
			return false;
		}
		Cell cell = map.getCell(coord);
		if (!(cell instanceof FillableCell) || cell.isFilled()) {
			return false;
		}
		Pipe currentPipe = pipeQueue.peek();
		if (currentPipe == null) {
			return false;
		}
		boolean placed = currentPipe.placeAt(coord);
		if (placed) {
			map.setCell(coord, currentPipe);
			cellStack.push(coord);
			pipeQueue.dequeue();
			numOfSteps++;
			delayBar.increment();
			return true;
		}
		return false;
	}
```

	public void skipPipe() {
		Pipe currentPipe = pipeQueue.peek();
		if (currentPipe != null) {
```java
			pipeQueue.dequeue();
			pipeQueue.enqueue(currentPipe);
		}
	}
```

	public boolean undoStep() {
		if (cellStack.isEmpty()) {
			return false;
		}
		Coordinate lastCoord = cellStack.pop();
		Cell cell = map.getCell(lastCoord);
		if (cell instanceof FillableCell) {
```java
			((FillableCell) cell).reset();
		} else {
		}
		numOfSteps--;
		delayBar.decrement();
		return true;
	}
```

	public void updateState() {
		int currentDistance = delayBar.getValue();
		map.fillTiles(currentDistance);
```java
	}
}
```

```java
package game;

import game.map.Map;
import game.map.cells.Cell;
import game.map.cells.FillableCell;
import game.pipes.Pipe;
import io.Deserializer;
import org.jetbrains.annotations.NotNull;
import org.jetbrains.annotations.Nullable;
import util.Coordinate;

import java.util.List;

public class Game {

	@NotNull
	private final Map map;
	@NotNull
	private final PipeQueue pipeQueue;
	@NotNull
	private final DelayBar delayBar;
	@NotNull
	private final CellStack cellStack = new CellStack();

	private int numOfSteps = 0;

	/**
	 * Creates a game with a given map and various properties.
	 *
	 * <p>
	 * This constructor is a convenience method for unit testing purposes.
	 * </p>
	 *
	 * @param rows Number of rows of the given map.
	 * @param cols Number of columns of the given map.
	 * @param delay Delay in number of rounds before filling the pipes.
	 * @param cellsRep String representation of the map, with columns delimited by {@code '\n'}.
	 * @param pipes List of pre-generated pipes, if any.
	 * @return A game constructed with the given parameters.
	 */
	@NotNull
	static Game fromString(int rows, int cols, int delay, @NotNull String cellsRep, @Nullable List<Pipe> pipes) {
		var cells = Deserializer.parseString(rows, cols, cellsRep);

		return new Game(rows, cols, delay, cells, pipes);
	}

	/**
	 * Displays the current game state.
	 */
	public void display() {
		map.display();
		System.out.println();
		pipeQueue.display();
		cellStack.display();
		System.out.println();
		delayBar.display();
	}

	/**
	 * @return Number of steps the player has taken.
	 */
	public int getNumOfSteps() {
		// TODO
		return 0;
	}

	public void Game(int rows, int cols) {
		this.map = new Map(rows + 2, cols + 2);
		this.pipeQueue = new PipeQueue();
		this.delayBar = new DelayBar(0);
		for (int r = 0; r < this.map.getRows(); r++) {
			for (int c = 0; c < this.map.getCols(); c++) {
				if (r == 0 || r == this.map.getRows() - 1 || c == 0 || c == this.map.getCols() - 1) {
					this.map.setCell(r, c, new Cell(Cell.Type.WALL));
				} else {
					this.map.setCell(r, c, new FillableCell());
				}
			}
		}
		this.numOfSteps = 0;
	}

	public void Game(int rows, int cols, int delay, Cell[][] cells, List<Pipe> pipes) {
		this.map = new Map(rows + 2, cols + 2);
		this.pipeQueue = new PipeQueue();
		this.delayBar = new DelayBar(delay);
		this.numOfSteps = 0;
		for (int r = 0; r < this.map.getRows(); r++) {
			for (int c = 0; c < this.map.getCols(); c++) {
				if (r == 0 || r == this.map.getRows() - 1 || c == 0 || c == this.map.getCols() - 1) {
					this.map.setCell(r, c, new Cell(Cell.Type.WALL));
				} else {
					this.map.setCell(r, c, cells[r - 1][c - 1]);
				}
			}
		}
		if (pipes != null) {
			for (Pipe pipe : pipes) {
				this.pipeQueue.enqueue(pipe);
			}
		}
	}

	public boolean placePipe(int row, char col) {
		int colIndex = col - 'A';
		int r = row;
		int c = colIndex + 1;
		Coordinate coord = new Coordinate(r, c);
		if (coord.getRow() < 1 || coord.getRow() >= map.getRows() - 1 || coord.getCol() < 1
				|| coord.getCol() >= map.getCols() - 1) {
			return false;
		}
		Cell cell = map.getCell(coord);
		if (!(cell instanceof FillableCell) || cell.isFilled()) {
			return false;
		}
		Pipe currentPipe = pipeQueue.peek();
		if (currentPipe == null) {
			return false;
		}
		boolean placed = currentPipe.placeAt(coord);
		if (placed) {
			map.setCell(coord, currentPipe);
			cellStack.push(coord);
			pipeQueue.dequeue();
			numOfSteps++;
			delayBar.increment();
			return true;
		}
		return false;
	}

	public void skipPipe() {
		Pipe currentPipe = pipeQueue.peek();
		if (currentPipe != null) {
			pipeQueue.dequeue();
			pipeQueue.enqueue(currentPipe);
		}
	}

	public boolean undoStep() {
		if (cellStack.isEmpty()) {
			return false;
		}
		Coordinate lastCoord = cellStack.pop();
		Cell cell = map.getCell(lastCoord);
		if (cell instanceof FillableCell) {
			((FillableCell) cell).reset();
		} else {
		}
		numOfSteps--;
		delayBar.decrement();
		return true;
	}

	public void updateState() {
		int currentDistance = delayBar.getValue();
		map.fillTiles(currentDistance);
	}
```

	public boolean hasWon() {
		for (int r = 1; r < map.getRows() - 1; r++) {
			for (int c = 1; c < map.getCols() - 1; c++) {
				Cell cell = map.getCell(r, c);
				if (cell instanceof FillableCell && !cell.isFilled()) {
					return false;
				}
			}
		}
		return true;
```java
	}
```

	public boolean hasLost() {
		return map.hasLost() && !hasWon();
	}
}

```java
package game;

import game.map.Map;
import game.map.cells.Cell;
import game.map.cells.FillableCell;
import game.pipes.Pipe;
import io.Deserializer;
import org.jetbrains.annotations.NotNull;
import org.jetbrains.annotations.Nullable;
import util.Coordinate;

import java.util.List;

public class Game {

    @NotNull
    private final Map map;
    @NotNull
    private final PipeQueue pipeQueue;
    @NotNull
    private final DelayBar delayBar;
    @NotNull
    private final CellStack cellStack = new CellStack();

    private int numOfSteps = 0;

    /**
     * Creates a game with a given map and various properties.
     *
     * <p>
     * This constructor is a convenience method for unit testing purposes.
     * </p>
     *
     * @param rows Number of rows of the given map.
     * @param cols Number of columns of the given map.
     * @param delay Delay in number of rounds before filling the pipes.
     * @param cellsRep String representation of the map, with columns delimited by {@code '\n'}.
     * @param pipes List of pre-generated pipes, if any.
     * @return A game constructed with the given parameters.
     */
    @NotNull
```
```java
    public static Game fromString(int rows, int cols, int delay, @NotNull String cellsRep, @Nullable List<Pipe> pipes) {
        var cells = Deserializer.parseString(rows, cols, cellsRep);
        return new Game(rows, cols, delay, cells, pipes);
    }

    /**
     * Displays the current game state.
     */
    public void display() {
        map.display();
        System.out.println();
        pipeQueue.display();
        cellStack.display();
        System.out.println();
        delayBar.display();
    }

    /**
     * @return Number of steps the player has taken.
     */
    public int getNumOfSteps() {
        return this.numOfSteps;
    }

    // Corrected constructors (removed 'void' return type)
    public Game(int rows, int cols) {
        this.map = new Map(rows + 2, cols + 2);
        this.pipeQueue = new PipeQueue();
        this.delayBar = new DelayBar(0);
        for (int r = 0; r < this.map.getRows(); r++) {
            for (int c = 0; c < this.map.getCols(); c++) {
                if (r == 0 || r == this.map.getRows() - 1 || c == 0 || c == this.map.getCols() - 1) {
                    this.map.setCell(r, c, new Cell(Cell.Type.WALL));
                } else {
                    this.map.setCell(r, c, new FillableCell());
                }
            }
        }
        this.numOfSteps = 0;
    }

    public Game(int rows, int cols, int delay, Cell[][] cells, List<Pipe> pipes) {
        this.map = new Map(rows + 2, cols + 2);
        this.pipeQueue = new PipeQueue();
        this.delayBar = new DelayBar(delay);
        this.numOfSteps = 0;
        for (int r = 0; r < this.map.getRows(); r++) {
            for (int c = 0; c < this.map.getCols(); c++) {
                if (r == 0 || r == this.map.getRows() - 1 || c == 0 || c == this.map.getCols() - 1) {
                    this.map.setCell(r, c, new Cell(Cell.Type.WALL));
                } else {
                    this.map.setCell(r, c, cells[r - 1][c - 1]);
                }
            }
        }
        if (pipes != null) {
            for (Pipe pipe : pipes) {
                this.pipeQueue.enqueue(pipe);
            }
        }
    }

    // ... rest of the class remains unchanged
}
```

```java
package game;

import game.map.Map;
import game.map.cells.Cell;
import game.map.cells.FillableCell;
import game.pipes.Pipe;
import io.Deserializer;
import org.jetbrains.annotations.NotNull;
import org.jetbrains.annotations.Nullable;
import util.Coordinate;

import java.util.List;

public class Game {

	@NotNull
	private final Map map;
	@NotNull
	private final PipeQueue pipeQueue;
	@NotNull
	private final DelayBar delayBar;
	@NotNull
	private final CellStack cellStack = new CellStack();

	private int numOfSteps = 0;

	/**
	 * Creates a game with a given map and various properties.
	 *
	 * <p>
	 * This constructor is a convenience method for unit testing purposes.
	 * </p>
	 *
	 * @param rows Number of rows of the given map.
	 * @param cols Number of columns of the given map.
	 * @param delay Delay in number of rounds before filling the pipes.
	 * @param cellsRep String representation of the map, with columns delimited by {@code '\n'}.
	 * @param pipes List of pre-generated pipes, if any.
	 * @return A game constructed with the given parameters.
	 */
	@NotNull
	static Game fromString(int rows, int cols, int delay, @NotNull String cellsRep, @Nullable List<Pipe> pipes) {
		var cells = Deserializer.parseString(rows, cols, cellsRep);

		return new Game(rows, cols, delay, cells, pipes);
	}

	/**
	 * Displays the current game state.
	 */
	public void display() {
		map.display();
		System.out.println();
		pipeQueue.display();
		cellStack.display();
		System.out.println();
		delayBar.display();
	}

	/**
	 * @return Number of steps the player has taken.
	 */
	public int getNumOfSteps() {
		// TODO
		return 0;
	}

	public void Game(int rows, int cols) {
		this.map = new Map(rows + 2, cols + 2);
		this.pipeQueue = new PipeQueue();
		this.delayBar = new DelayBar(0);
		for (int r = 0; r < this.map.getRows(); r++) {
			for (int c = 0; c < this.map.getCols(); c++) {
				if (r == 0 || r == this.map.getRows() - 1 || c == 0 || c == this.map.getCols() - 1) {
					this.map.setCell(r, c, new Cell(Cell.Type.WALL));
				} else {
					this.map.setCell(r, c, new FillableCell());
				}
			}
		}
		this.numOfSteps = 0;
	}

	public void Game(int rows, int cols, int delay, Cell[][] cells, List<Pipe> pipes) {
		this.map = new Map(rows + 2, cols + 2);
		this.pipeQueue = new PipeQueue();
		this.delayBar = new DelayBar(delay);
		this.numOfSteps = 0;
		for (int r = 0; r < this.map.getRows(); r++) {
			for (int c = 0; c < this.map.getCols(); c++) {
				if (r == 0 || r == this.map.getRows() - 1 || c == 0 || c == this.map.getCols() - 1) {
					this.map.setCell(r, c, new Cell(Cell.Type.WALL));
				} else {
					this.map.setCell(r, c, cells[r - 1][c - 1]);
				}
			}
		}
		if (pipes != null) {
			for (Pipe pipe : pipes) {
				this.pipeQueue.enqueue(pipe);
			}
		}
	}

	public boolean placePipe(int row, char col) {
		int colIndex = col - 'A';
		int r = row;
		int c = colIndex + 1;
		Coordinate coord = new Coordinate(r, c);
		if (coord.getRow() < 1 || coord.getRow() >= map.getRows() - 1 || coord.getCol() < 1
				|| coord.getCol() >= map.getCols() - 1) {
			return false;
		}
		Cell cell = map.getCell(coord);
		if (!(cell instanceof FillableCell) || cell.isFilled()) {
			return false;
		}
		Pipe currentPipe = pipeQueue.peek();
		if (currentPipe == null) {
			return false;
		}
		boolean placed = currentPipe.placeAt(coord);
		if (placed) {
			map.setCell(coord, currentPipe);
			cellStack.push(coord);
			pipeQueue.dequeue();
			numOfSteps++;
			delayBar.increment();
			return true;
		}
		return false;
	}

	public void skipPipe() {
		Pipe currentPipe = pipeQueue.peek();
		if (currentPipe != null) {
			pipeQueue.dequeue();
			pipeQueue.enqueue(currentPipe);
		}
	}

	public boolean undoStep() {
		if (cellStack.isEmpty()) {
			return false;
		}
		Coordinate lastCoord = cellStack.pop();
		Cell cell = map.getCell(lastCoord);
		if (cell instanceof FillableCell) {
			((FillableCell) cell).reset();
		} else {
		}
		numOfSteps--;
		delayBar.decrement();
		return true;
	}

	public void updateState() {
		int currentDistance = delayBar.getValue();
		map.fillTiles(currentDistance);
	}

	public boolean hasWon() {
		for (int r = 1; r < map.getRows() - 1; r++) {
			for (int c = 1; c < map.getCols() - 1; c++) {
				Cell cell = map.getCell(r, c);
				if (cell instanceof FillableCell && !cell.isFilled()) {
					return false;
				}
			}
		}
		return true;
	}

	public boolean hasLost() {
		return map.hasLost() && !hasWon();
	}
}
```

package game;

import game.map.Map;
import game.map.cells.Cell;
import game.map.cells.FillableCell;
import game.pipes.Pipe;
import io.Deserializer;
import org.jetbrains.annotations.NotNull;
import org.jetbrains.annotations.Nullable;
import util.Coordinate;

import java.util.List;

public class Game {

    @NotNull
    private final Map map;
    @NotNull
    private final PipeQueue pipeQueue;
    @NotNull
    private final DelayBar delayBar;
    @NotNull
    private final CellStack cellStack = new CellStack();

    private int numOfSteps = 0;

    /**
     * Creates a game with a given map and various properties.
     *
     * <p>
     * This constructor is a convenience method for unit testing purposes.
     * </p>
     *
     * @param rows Number of rows of the given map.
     * @param cols Number of columns of the given map.
     */
    public Game(int rows, int cols) {
        this.map = new Map(rows + 2, cols + 2);
        this.pipeQueue = new PipeQueue();
        this.delayBar = new DelayBar(0);
        for (int r = 0; r < this.map.getRows(); r++) {
            for (int c = 0; c < this.map.getCols(); c++) {
                if (r == 0 || r == this.map.getRows() - 1 || c == 0 || c == this.map.getCols() - 1) {
                    this.map.setCell(r, c, new Cell(Cell.Type.WALL));
                } else {
                    this.map.setCell(r, c, new FillableCell());
                }
            }
        }
        this.numOfSteps = 0;
    }

```java
    /**
     * Creates a game with specified parameters.
     *
     * @param rows Number of rows.
     * @param cols Number of columns.
     * @param delay Delay in rounds.
     * @param cells 2D array of cells representing the map.
     * @param pipes List of pipes.
     */
    public Game(int rows, int cols, int delay, Cell[][] cells, List<Pipe> pipes) {
        this.map = new Map(rows + 2, cols + 2);
        this.pipeQueue = new PipeQueue();
        this.delayBar = new DelayBar(delay);
        this.numOfSteps = 0;
        for (int r = 0; r < this.map.getRows(); r++) {
            for (int c = 0; c < this.map.getCols(); c++) {
                if (r == 0 || r == this.map.getRows() - 1 || c == 0 || c == this.map.getCols() - 1) {
                    this.map.setCell(r, c, new Cell(Cell.Type.WALL));
                } else {
                    this.map.setCell(r, c, cells[r - 1][c - 1]);
                }
            }
        }
        if (pipes != null) {
            for (Pipe pipe : pipes) {
                this.pipeQueue.enqueue(pipe);
            }
        }
    }

    // Existing methods...

    @NotNull
    public static Game fromString(int rows, int cols, int delay, @NotNull String cellsRep, @Nullable List<Pipe> pipes) {
        var cells = Deserializer.parseString(rows, cols, cellsRep);
        return new Game(rows, cols, delay, cells, pipes);
    }

    public int getNumOfSteps() {
        return this.numOfSteps;
    }
}
```

```java
			pipeQueue.add(generateNewPipe());
		}
	}
```

```java
	void PipeQueue(List<Pipe> pipes) {
		this.pipeQueue = new LinkedList<>();
		this.pipeQueue.addAll(pipes);
		while (this.pipeQueue.size() < MAX_GEN_LENGTH) {
			this.pipeQueue.add(generateNewPipe());
		}
	}
```

	Pipe peek() {
		if (pipeQueue.isEmpty()) {
			throw new IllegalStateException("No pipes in the queue");
		}
		return pipeQueue.getFirst();
```java
	}
```

	void consume() {
		if (!pipeQueue.isEmpty()) {
			pipeQueue.removeFirst();
		}
		while (pipeQueue.size() < MAX_GEN_LENGTH) {
			pipeQueue.add(generateNewPipe());
		}
	}

```java
	void undo(final Pipe pipe) {
```
```java
		pipeQueue.addFirst(pipe);
	}
```
}

```java
    this.rows = rows;
```

```java
	@NotNull
	private TerminationCell.CreateInfo generateStartCellInfo() {
		Random rng = new Random();

		Coordinate coord;
		Direction direction;

		do {
			int row = rng.nextInt(rows);
			int col = rng.nextInt(cols);
			coord = new Coordinate(row, col);

			int dir = rng.nextInt(4);
			direction = Direction.values()[dir];

			if (row == 0 || row == rows - 1) {
				continue;
			}
			if (col == 0 || col == cols - 1) {
				continue;
			}
			switch (direction) {
			case UP:
				if (row <= 1) {
					continue;
				}
				break;
			case DOWN:
				if (row >= rows - 2) {
					continue;
				}
				break;
			case LEFT:
				if (col <= 1) {
					continue;
				}
				break;
			case RIGHT:
				if (col >= cols - 2) {
					continue;
				}
				break;
			}

			break;
		} while (true);

		return new TerminationCell.CreateInfo(coord, direction);
	}

	@NotNull
	private TerminationCell.CreateInfo generateEndCellInfo() {
		Random rng = new Random();

		Coordinate coord;
		Direction direction;

		do {
			// false -> X-axis, true -> Y-axis
			boolean axisToClamp = rng.nextInt(2) == 1;
			int row = axisToClamp ? (rng.nextInt(2) == 1 ? rows - 1 : 0) : rng.nextInt(rows - 2) + 1;
			int col = !axisToClamp ? (rng.nextInt(2) == 1 ? cols - 1 : 0) : rng.nextInt(cols - 2) + 1;

			if (row == col) {
				continue;
			}

			coord = new Coordinate(row, col);

			if (axisToClamp) {
				if (row == 0) {
					direction = Direction.UP;
				} else {
					direction = Direction.DOWN;
				}
			} else {
				if (col == 0) {
					direction = Direction.LEFT;
				} else {
					direction = Direction.RIGHT;
				}
			}

			var adjacentCell = coord.add(direction.getOpposite().getOffset());
			if (adjacentCell.equals(sourceCell.coord)) {
				continue;
			}

			break;
		} while (true);

		return new TerminationCell.CreateInfo(coord, direction);
	}
```

**Proposed implementation:**

```java
public Map(int rows, int cols, Cell[][] cells) {
    this.rows = rows;
    this.cols = cols;
    this.cells = new Cell[rows][cols];

    // Copy the provided cells into the class field
    for (int r = 0; r < rows; r++) {
        System.arraycopy(cells[r], 0, this.cells[r], 0, cols);
    }

    // Initialize source and sink references
    TerminationCell foundSource = null;
    TerminationCell foundSink = null;

    // Validate and locate source and sink cells
    int sourceCount = 0;
    int sinkCount = 0;

    for (int r = 0; r < rows; r++) {
        for (int c = 0; c < cols; c++) {
            Cell cell = this.cells[r][c];

            if (cell instanceof TerminationCell) {
                TerminationCell termCell = (TerminationCell) cell;
                if (termCell.isSource()) {
                    sourceCount++;
                    // Check source is not on edge
                    if (r == 0 || r == rows - 1 || c == 0 || c == cols - 1) {
                        throw new IllegalArgumentException("Source cannot be on the edge");
                    }
                    // Check source does not point into a wall
                    Direction dir = termCell.getDirection();
                    Coordinate targetCoord = new Coordinate(r, c).add(dir.getOffset());
                    if (isWithinBounds(targetCoord) && cells[targetCoord.row][targetCoord.col] instanceof Wall) {
                        throw new IllegalArgumentException("Source cannot point into a wall");
                    }
                    foundSource = termCell;
                } else if (termCell.isSink()) {
                    sinkCount++;
                    // Check sink is on edge
                    if (!(r == 0 || r == rows - 1 || c == 0 || c == cols - 1)) {
                        throw new IllegalArgumentException("Sink must be on the edge");
                    }
                    // Check sink points outside the map
                    Direction dir = termCell.getDirection();
                    Coordinate targetCoord = new Coordinate(r, c).add(dir.getOffset());
                    if (isWithinBounds(targetCoord)) {
                        throw new IllegalArgumentException("Sink must point outside the map");
                    }
                    foundSink = termCell;
                }
            }
        }
    }

    if (sourceCount != 1) {
        throw new IllegalArgumentException("Exactly one source cell required");
    }
    if (sinkCount != 1) {
        throw new IllegalArgumentException("Exactly one sink cell required");
    }

    this.sourceCell = foundSource;
    this.sinkCell = foundSink;
}

// Helper method to check bounds
private boolean isWithinBounds(@NotNull Coordinate coord) {
    return coord.row >= 0 && coord.row < rows && coord.col >= 0 && coord.col < cols;
}
```

```java
	@NotNull
	private TerminationCell.CreateInfo generateStartCellInfo() {
		Random rng = new Random();

		Coordinate coord;
		Direction direction;

		do {
			int row = rng.nextInt(rows);
			int col = rng.nextInt(cols);
			coord = new Coordinate(row, col);

			int dir = rng.nextInt(4);
			direction = Direction.values()[dir];

			if (row == 0 || row == rows - 1) {
				continue;
			}
			if (col == 0 || col == cols - 1) {
				continue;
			}
			switch (direction) {
			case UP:
				if (row <= 1) {
					continue;
				}
				break;
			case DOWN:
				if (row >= rows - 2) {
					continue;
				}
				break;
			case LEFT:
				if (col <= 1) {
					continue;
				}
				break;
			case RIGHT:
				if (col >= cols - 2) {
					continue;
				}
				break;
			}

			break;
		} while (true);

		return new TerminationCell.CreateInfo(coord, direction);
	}

	@NotNull
	private TerminationCell.CreateInfo generateEndCellInfo() {
		Random rng = new Random();

		Coordinate coord;
		Direction direction;

		do {
			// false -> X-axis, true -> Y-axis
			boolean axisToClamp = rng.nextInt(2) == 1;
			int row = axisToClamp ? (rng.nextInt(2) == 1 ? rows - 1 : 0) : rng.nextInt(rows - 2) + 1;
			int col = !axisToClamp ? (rng.nextInt(2) == 1 ? cols - 1 : 0) : rng.nextInt(cols - 2) + 1;

			if (row == col) {
				continue;
			}

			coord = new Coordinate(row, col);

			if (axisToClamp) {
				if (row == 0) {
					direction = Direction.UP;
				} else {
					direction = Direction.DOWN;
				}
			} else {
				if (col == 0) {
					direction = Direction.LEFT;
				} else {
					direction = Direction.RIGHT;
				}
			}

			var adjacentCell = coord.add(direction.getOpposite().getOffset());
			if (adjacentCell.equals(sourceCell.coord)) {
				continue;
			}

			break;
		} while (true);

		return new TerminationCell.CreateInfo(coord, direction);
	}
```

                    Coordinate targetCoord = new Coordinate(r, c).add(dir.getOffset());
                    if (isWithinBounds(targetCoord)) {
                        throw new IllegalArgumentException("Sink must point outside the map");
                    }
                    foundSink = termCell;
                }
            }
        }
    }

    if (sourceCount != 1) {
        throw new IllegalArgumentException("Exactly one source cell required");
    }
    if (sinkCount != 1) {
        throw new IllegalArgumentException("Exactly one sink cell required");
    }

    this.sourceCell = foundSource;
    this.sinkCell = foundSink;
}

```java
	@NotNull
	private TerminationCell.CreateInfo generateStartCellInfo() {
		Random rng = new Random();

		Coordinate coord;
		Direction direction;

		do {
			int row = rng.nextInt(rows);
			int col = rng.nextInt(cols);
			coord = new Coordinate(row, col);

			int dir = rng.nextInt(4);
			direction = Direction.values()[dir];

			if (row == 0 || row == rows - 1) {
				continue;
			}
			if (col == 0 || col == cols - 1) {
				continue;
			}
			switch (direction) {
			case UP:
				if (row <= 1) {
					continue;
				}
				break;
			case DOWN:
				if (row >= rows - 2) {
					continue;
				}
				break;
			case LEFT:
				if (col <= 1) {
					continue;
				}
				break;
			case RIGHT:
				if (col >= cols - 2) {
					continue;
				}
				break;
			}

			break;
		} while (true);

		return new TerminationCell.CreateInfo(coord, direction);
	}

	@NotNull
	private TerminationCell.CreateInfo generateEndCellInfo() {
		Random rng = new Random();

		Coordinate coord;
		Direction direction;

		do {
			// false -> X-axis, true -> Y-axis
			boolean axisToClamp = rng.nextInt(2) == 1;
			int row = axisToClamp ? (rng.nextInt(2) == 1 ? rows - 1 : 0) : rng.nextInt(rows - 2) + 1;
			int col = !axisToClamp ? (rng.nextInt(2) == 1 ? cols - 1 : 0) : rng.nextInt(cols - 2) + 1;

			if (row == col) {
				continue;
			}

			coord = new Coordinate(row, col);

			if (axisToClamp) {
				if (row == 0) {
					direction = Direction.UP;
				} else {
					direction = Direction.DOWN;
				}
			} else {
				if (col == 0) {
					direction = Direction.LEFT;
				} else {
					direction = Direction.RIGHT;
				}
			}

			var adjacentCell = coord.add(direction.getOpposite().getOffset());
			if (adjacentCell.equals(sourceCell.coord)) {
				continue;
			}

			break;
		} while (true);

		return new TerminationCell.CreateInfo(coord, direction);
	}

			}

			System.out.println();
		}

		printColumns.run();
	}

	public void Map(int rows, int cols) {
		this.rows = rows;
		this.cols = cols;
		this.cells = new Cell[rows][cols];
		for (int r = 0; r < rows; r++) {
			for (int c = 0; c < cols; c++) {
				cells[r][c] = new FillableCell();
			}
		}
		TerminationCell.CreateInfo sourceInfo = generateStartCellInfo();
		sourceCell = new TerminationCell(sourceInfo.coord, sourceInfo.direction);
		cells[sourceInfo.coord.row][sourceInfo.coord.col] = sourceCell;
		TerminationCell.CreateInfo sinkInfo = generateEndCellInfo();
		sinkCell = new TerminationCell(sinkInfo.coord, sinkInfo.direction);
		cells[sinkInfo.coord.row][sinkInfo.coord.col] = sinkCell;
	}

	public void Map(int rows, int cols, Cell[][] cells) {
		this.rows = rows;
		this.cols = cols;
		this.cells = new Cell[rows][cols];
		for (int r = 0; r < rows; r++) {
			System.arraycopy(cells[r], 0, this.cells[r], 0, cols);
		}
		TerminationCell foundSource = null;
		TerminationCell foundSink = null;
		int sourceCount = 0;
		int sinkCount = 0;
		for (int r = 0; r < rows; r++) {
			for (int c = 0; c < cols; c++) {
				Cell cell = this.cells[r][c];
				if (cell instanceof TerminationCell) {
					TerminationCell termCell = (TerminationCell) cell;
					if (termCell.isSource()) {
						sourceCount++;
						if (r == 0 || r == rows - 1 || c == 0 || c == cols - 1) {
							throw new IllegalArgumentException("Source cannot be on the edge");
						}
						Direction dir = termCell.getDirection();
						Coordinate targetCoord = new Coordinate(r, c).add(dir.getOffset());
						if (isWithinBounds(targetCoord) && cells[targetCoord.row][targetCoord.col] instanceof Wall) {
							throw new IllegalArgumentException("Source cannot point into a wall");
						}
						foundSource = termCell;
					} else if (termCell.isSink()) {
						sinkCount++;
						if (!(r == 0 || r == rows - 1 || c == 0 || c == cols - 1)) {
							throw new IllegalArgumentException("Sink must be on the edge");
						}
						Direction dir = termCell.getDirection();
						Coordinate targetCoord = new Coordinate(r, c).add(dir.getOffset());
						if (isWithinBounds(targetCoord)) {
							throw new IllegalArgumentException("Sink must point outside the map");
						}
						foundSink = termCell;
					}
				}
			}
		}
		if (sourceCount != 1) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("Exactly one source cell required");
		}
		if (sinkCount != 1) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("Exactly one sink cell required");
		}
		this.sourceCell = foundSource;
		this.sinkCell = foundSink;
	}
}
```

```java
		return new TerminationCell.CreateInfo(coord, direction);
	}

	@NotNull
	private TerminationCell.CreateInfo generateEndCellInfo() {
		Random rng = new Random();

		Coordinate coord;
		Direction direction;

		do {
			// false -> X-axis, true -> Y-axis
			boolean axisToClamp = rng.nextInt(2) == 1;
			int row = axisToClamp ? (rng.nextInt(2) == 1 ? rows - 1 : 0) : rng.nextInt(rows - 2) + 1;
			int col = !axisToClamp ? (rng.nextInt(2) == 1 ? cols - 1 : 0) : rng.nextInt(cols - 2) + 1;

			if (row == col) {
				continue;
			}

			coord = new Coordinate(row, col);

			if (axisToClamp) {
				if (row == 0) {
					direction = Direction.UP;
				} else {
					direction = Direction.DOWN;
				}
			} else {
				if (col == 0) {
					direction = Direction.LEFT;
				} else {
					direction = Direction.RIGHT;
				}
			}

			var adjacentCell = coord.add(direction.getOpposite().getOffset());
			if (adjacentCell.equals(sourceCell.coord)) {
				continue;
			}

			break;
		} while (true);

		return new TerminationCell.CreateInfo(coord, direction);
	}

		for (int i = 0; i < rows; ++i) {
			if (i != 0 && i != rows - 1) {
				System.out.print(String.format("%1$" + padLength + "s", i));
			} else {
				System.out.print(StringUtils.createPadding(padLength, ' '));

			if (i != 0 && i != rows - 1) {
				System.out.print(i);
			}

			System.out.println();
		}

		printColumns.run();
	}

	public void Map(int rows, int cols) {
		this.rows = rows;
		this.cols = cols;
		this.cells = new Cell[rows][cols];
		for (int r = 0; r < rows; r++) {
			for (int c = 0; c < cols; c++) {
				cells[r][c] = new FillableCell();
			}
		}
		TerminationCell.CreateInfo sourceInfo = generateStartCellInfo();
		sourceCell = new TerminationCell(sourceInfo.coord, sourceInfo.direction);
		cells[sourceInfo.coord.row][sourceInfo.coord.col] = sourceCell;
		TerminationCell.CreateInfo sinkInfo = generateEndCellInfo();
		sinkCell = new TerminationCell(sinkInfo.coord, sinkInfo.direction);
		cells[sinkInfo.coord.row][sinkInfo.coord.col] = sinkCell;
	}

	public void Map(int rows, int cols, Cell[][] cells) {
		this.rows = rows;
		this.cols = cols;
		this.cells = new Cell[rows][cols];
		for (int r = 0; r < rows; r++) {
			System.arraycopy(cells[r], 0, this.cells[r], 0, cols);
		}
		TerminationCell foundSource = null;
		TerminationCell foundSink = null;
		int sourceCount = 0;
		int sinkCount = 0;
		for (int r = 0; r < rows; r++) {
			for (int c = 0; c < cols; c++) {
				Cell cell = this.cells[r][c];
				if (cell instanceof TerminationCell) {
					TerminationCell termCell = (TerminationCell) cell;
					if (termCell.isSource()) {
						sourceCount++;
						if (r == 0 || r == rows - 1 || c == 0 || c == cols - 1) {
							throw new IllegalArgumentException("Source cannot be on the edge");
						}
						Direction dir = termCell.getDirection();
						Coordinate targetCoord = new Coordinate(r, c).add(dir.getOffset());
						if (isWithinBounds(targetCoord) && cells[targetCoord.row][targetCoord.col] instanceof Wall) {
							throw new IllegalArgumentException("Source cannot point into a wall");
						}
						foundSource = termCell;
					} else if (termCell.isSink()) {
						sinkCount++;
						if (!(r == 0 || r == rows - 1 || c == 0 || c == cols - 1)) {
							throw new IllegalArgumentException("Sink must be on the edge");
						}
						Direction dir = termCell.getDirection();
						Coordinate targetCoord = new Coordinate(r, c).add(dir.getOffset());
						if (isWithinBounds(targetCoord)) {
							throw new IllegalArgumentException("Sink must point outside the map");
						}
						foundSink = termCell;
					}
				}
			}
		}
		if (sourceCount != 1) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("Exactly one source cell required");
		}
		if (sinkCount != 1) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("Exactly one sink cell required");
		}
		this.sourceCell = foundSource;
		this.sinkCell = foundSink;
	}

	boolean tryPlacePipe(int row, int col, Pipe p) {
		int r = row - 1;
		int c = col - 1;
		if (r < 0 || r >= rows || c < 0 || c >= cols) {
			return false;
		}
		Cell targetCell = cells[r][c];
		if (!(targetCell instanceof FillableCell)) {
			return false;
		}
		FillableCell fillable = (FillableCell) targetCell;
		if (fillable.isOccupied()) {
			return false;
		}
		fillable.setPipe(p);
		return true;
	}
}
```

Response Text:---
The `fillTiles` method should fill all cells within a specified Manhattan distance from the `sourceCell`. A common approach is to perform a Breadth-First Search (BFS) starting from the `sourceCell`, tracking the distance from it, and filling cells until the maximum distance is reached.

Here's a complete implementation:

```java
public void fillTiles(int distance) {
    if (sourceCell == null || cells == null || rows == 0 || cols == 0) {
        return;
    }

    // Clear previous filled tiles
    filledTiles.clear();

    // Queue for BFS: stores pairs of Coordinate and current distance
    Queue<CoordinateDistance> queue = new ArrayDeque<>();
    queue.add(new CoordinateDistance(sourceCell.getCoordinate(), 0));
    filledTiles.add(sourceCell.getCoordinate());

    while (!queue.isEmpty()) {
        CoordinateDistance current = queue.poll();
        int currentDist = current.distance;
        if (currentDist >= distance) {
            continue;
        }

        for (Direction dir : Direction.values()) {
            Coordinate neighbor = current.coord.add(dir.getOffset());
            if (isWithinBounds(neighbor) && !filledTiles.contains(neighbor)) {
                Cell cell = cells[neighbor.row][neighbor.col];
                if (cell instanceof FillableCell) {
                    // Fill the cell
                    ((FillableCell) cell).setFilled();
                    filledTiles.add(neighbor);
                    queue.add(new CoordinateDistance(neighbor, currentDist + 1));
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

// Helper class to store coordinate with distance
private static class CoordinateDistance {
    final Coordinate coord;
    final int distance;

    CoordinateDistance(Coordinate coord, int distance) {
        this.coord = coord;
        this.distance = distance;
    }
}

// Helper method to check bounds
private boolean isWithinBounds(@NotNull Coordinate coord) {
    return coord.row >= 0 && coord.row < rows && coord.col >= 0 && coord.col < cols;
}
```

**Explanation:**
- Initializes a queue with the `sourceCell` at distance 0.
- Uses BFS to explore neighboring cells.
- Fills cells within the specified `distance`.
- Tracks filled cells in `filledTiles` to avoid revisiting.
- Uses a helper class `CoordinateDistance` to keep track of each cell's distance from the source.

This approach ensures all cells within the Manhattan distance are filled correctly.

```java
		Coordinate coord;
		Direction direction;

		do {
			int row = rng.nextInt(rows);
			int col = rng.nextInt(cols);
			coord = new Coordinate(row, col);

			int dir = rng.nextInt(4);
			direction = Direction.values()[dir];

			}

			case DOWN:

				break;
			}

		} while (true);

	@NotNull
	private TerminationCell.CreateInfo generateEndCellInfo() {
		Random rng = new Random();

		Coordinate coord;
		Direction direction;

		do {
			// false -> X-axis, true -> Y-axis
			boolean axisToClamp = rng.nextInt(2) == 1;
			int row = axisToClamp ? (rng.nextInt(2) == 1 ? rows - 1 : 0) : rng.nextInt(rows - 2) + 1;
			int col = !axisToClamp ? (rng.nextInt(2) == 1 ? cols - 1 : 0) : rng.nextInt(cols - 2) + 1;

			if (row == col) {
				continue;
			}

			coord = new Coordinate(row, col);

			if (axisToClamp) {
				if (row == 0) {
					direction = Direction.UP;
				} else {
					direction = Direction.DOWN;
				}
			} else {
				if (col == 0) {
					direction = Direction.LEFT;
				} else {
					direction = Direction.RIGHT;
				}
			}

			var adjacentCell = coord.add(direction.getOpposite().getOffset());
			if (adjacentCell.equals(sourceCell.coord)) {
				continue;
			}

			break;
		} while (true);

		return new TerminationCell.CreateInfo(coord, direction);
	}

		sourceCell = new TerminationCell(sourceInfo.coord, sourceInfo.direction);
		cells[sourceInfo.coord.row][sourceInfo.coord.col] = sourceCell;
		TerminationCell.CreateInfo sinkInfo = generateEndCellInfo();
		sinkCell = new TerminationCell(sinkInfo.coord, sinkInfo.direction);
		cells[sinkInfo.coord.row][sinkInfo.coord.col] = sinkCell;
	}

	public void Map(int rows, int cols, Cell[][] cells) {
		this.rows = rows;
		this.cols = cols;
		this.cells = new Cell[rows][cols];
		for (int r = 0; r < rows; r++) {
			System.arraycopy(cells[r], 0, this.cells[r], 0, cols);
		}
		TerminationCell foundSource = null;
		TerminationCell foundSink = null;
		int sourceCount = 0;
		int sinkCount = 0;
		for (int r = 0; r < rows; r++) {
			for (int c = 0; c < cols; c++) {
				Cell cell = this.cells[r][c];
				if (cell instanceof TerminationCell) {
					TerminationCell termCell = (TerminationCell) cell;
					if (termCell.isSource()) {
						sourceCount++;
						if (r == 0 || r == rows - 1 || c == 0 || c == cols - 1) {
							throw new IllegalArgumentException("Source cannot be on the edge");
						}
						Direction dir = termCell.getDirection();
						Coordinate targetCoord = new Coordinate(r, c).add(dir.getOffset());
						if (isWithinBounds(targetCoord) && cells[targetCoord.row][targetCoord.col] instanceof Wall) {
							throw new IllegalArgumentException("Source cannot point into a wall");
						}
						foundSource = termCell;
					} else if (termCell.isSink()) {
						sinkCount++;
						if (!(r == 0 || r == rows - 1 || c == 0 || c == cols - 1)) {
							throw new IllegalArgumentException("Sink must be on the edge");
						}
						Direction dir = termCell.getDirection();
						Coordinate targetCoord = new Coordinate(r, c).add(dir.getOffset());
						if (isWithinBounds(targetCoord)) {
							throw new IllegalArgumentException("Sink must point outside the map");
						}
						foundSink = termCell;
					}
				}
			}
		}
		if (sourceCount != 1) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("Exactly one source cell required");
		}
		if (sinkCount != 1) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("Exactly one sink cell required");
		}
		this.sourceCell = foundSource;
		this.sinkCell = foundSink;
	}

	boolean tryPlacePipe(int row, int col, Pipe p) {
		int r = row - 1;
		int c = col - 1;
		if (r < 0 || r >= rows || c < 0 || c >= cols) {
			return false;
		}
		Cell targetCell = cells[r][c];
		if (!(targetCell instanceof FillableCell)) {
			return false;
		}
		FillableCell fillable = (FillableCell) targetCell;
		if (fillable.isOccupied()) {
			return false;
		}
		fillable.setPipe(p);
		return true;
	}

	public void undo(final Coordinate coord) {
		int row = coord.row;
		int col = coord.col;
		if (!isWithinBounds(coord)) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("Coordinate out of bounds");
		}
		Cell currentCell = cells[row][col];
		if (!(currentCell instanceof FillableCell)) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("Cell is not fillable");
		}
		cells[row][col] = new FillableCell();
	}
```

public void fillTiles(int distance) {
    if (sourceCell == null || cells == null || rows == 0 || cols == 0) {
        return;
    }

    // Clear previous filled tiles
    filledTiles.clear();

    // Queue for BFS: stores pairs of Coordinate and current distance
    Queue<CoordinateDistance> queue = new ArrayDeque<>();
    queue.add(new CoordinateDistance(sourceCell.getCoordinate(), 0));
    filledTiles.add(sourceCell.getCoordinate());

    while (!queue.isEmpty()) {
        CoordinateDistance current = queue.poll();
        int currentDist = current.distance;
        if (currentDist >= distance) {
            continue;
        }

        for (Direction dir : Direction.values()) {
            Coordinate neighbor = current.coord.add(dir.getOffset());
            if (isWithinBounds(neighbor) && !filledTiles.contains(neighbor)) {
                Cell cell = cells[neighbor.row][neighbor.col];
                if (cell instanceof FillableCell) {
                    // Fill the cell
                    ((FillableCell) cell).setFilled();
                    filledTiles.add(neighbor);
                    queue.add(new CoordinateDistance(neighbor, currentDist + 1));
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

Response Text:---
The `checkPath()` method should perform a Breadth-First Search (BFS) starting from the source cell to determine if there's a valid path to the sink cell through the placed pipes. The algorithm involves:

- Using a queue to traverse cells.
- Tracking visited cells to avoid cycles.
- Moving only through cells that contain pipes or are the source/sink.
- Ensuring movement respects pipe directions and connectivity.

Here's a complete implementation of `checkPath()`:

```java
public boolean checkPath() {
    if (sourceCell == null || sinkCell == null) {
        return false;
    }

    Set<Coordinate> visited = new HashSet<>();
    Queue<Coordinate> queue = new ArrayDeque<>();
    Coordinate start = sourceCell.getCoordinate();
    queue.add(start);
    visited.add(start);

    while (!queue.isEmpty()) {
        Coordinate current = queue.poll();

        // Check if we've reached the sink
        if (current.equals(sinkCell.getCoordinate())) {
            return true;
        }

        Cell currentCell = cells[current.row][current.col];

        // If current cell is source or contains a pipe, explore neighbors
        if (currentCell instanceof TerminationCell || currentCell instanceof Pipe) {
            // For each direction, check if movement is possible
            for (Direction dir : Direction.values()) {
                Coordinate neighbor = current.add(dir.getOffset());

                if (!isWithinBounds(neighbor) || visited.contains(neighbor)) {
                    continue;
                }

                Cell neighborCell = cells[neighbor.row][neighbor.col];

                // Only proceed if neighbor is not a wall and is connectable
                if (neighborCell instanceof FillableCell || neighborCell instanceof TerminationCell) {
                    // Check if the pipe or cell at neighbor allows entry from current direction
                    boolean canEnter = false;

                    if (neighborCell instanceof TerminationCell) {
                        // For sink, check if direction matches sink's entry direction
                        TerminationCell sink = (TerminationCell) neighborCell;
                        if (neighbor.equals(sink.getCoordinate()) && sink.getDirection() == dir.getOpposite()) {
                            canEnter = true;
                        }
                    } else if (neighborCell instanceof Pipe) {
                        Pipe pipe = (Pipe) neighborCell;
                        // Check if pipe allows entry from current direction
                        if (pipe.allowsEntryFrom(dir.getOpposite())) {
                            // Also check if pipe allows exit in the direction from current cell
                            if (pipe.allowsExitTo(dir)) {
                                canEnter = true;
                            }
                        }
                    }

                    if (canEnter) {
                        visited.add(neighbor);
                        queue.add(neighbor);
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
    return false;
}
```

**Note:**  
- This implementation assumes that `Pipe` has methods `allowsEntryFrom(Direction)` and `allowsExitTo(Direction)` to determine connectivity based on pipe orientation.  
- The method `isWithinBounds()` checks if a coordinate is within the map boundaries.  
- The BFS explores all reachable cells connected via pipes or source/sink, respecting pipe directions.

If your `Pipe` class does not have these methods, you'll need to implement logic based on pipe types and their allowed directions.

```java
	@NotNull
	private TerminationCell.CreateInfo generateStartCellInfo() {
		Random rng = new Random();

		Coordinate coord;
		Direction direction;

		do {
			int row = rng.nextInt(rows);
			int col = rng.nextInt(cols);
			coord = new Coordinate(row, col);

			int dir = rng.nextInt(4);
			direction = Direction.values()[dir];

			if (row == 0 || row == rows - 1) {
				continue;
			}
			if (col == 0 || col == cols - 1) {
				continue;
			}
			switch (direction) {
			case UP:
				if (row <= 1) {
					continue;
				}
				break;
			case DOWN:
				if (row >= rows - 2) {
					continue;
				}
				break;
			case LEFT:
				if (col <= 1) {
					continue;
				}
				break;
			case RIGHT:
				if (col >= cols - 2) {
					continue;
				}
				break;
			}

			break;
		} while (true);

		return new TerminationCell.CreateInfo(coord, direction);
	}

	@NotNull
	private TerminationCell.CreateInfo generateEndCellInfo() {
		Random rng = new Random();

		Coordinate coord;
		Direction direction;

		do {
			// false -> X-axis, true -> Y-axis
			boolean axisToClamp = rng.nextInt(2) == 1;
			int row = axisToClamp ? (rng.nextInt(2) == 1 ? rows - 1 : 0) : rng.nextInt(rows - 2) + 1;
			int col = !axisToClamp ? (rng.nextInt(2) == 1 ? cols - 1 : 0) : rng.nextInt(cols - 2) + 1;

			if (row == col) {
				continue;
			}

			coord = new Coordinate(row, col);

			if (axisToClamp) {
				if (row == 0) {
					direction = Direction.UP;
				} else {
					direction = Direction.DOWN;
				}
			} else {
				if (col == 0) {
					direction = Direction.LEFT;
				} else {
					direction = Direction.RIGHT;
				}
			}

			var adjacentCell = coord.add(direction.getOpposite().getOffset());
			if (adjacentCell.equals(sourceCell.coord)) {
				continue;
			}

			break;
		} while (true);

		return new TerminationCell.CreateInfo(coord, direction);
	}

	public void Map(int rows, int cols, Cell[][] cells) {
		this.rows = rows;
		this.cols = cols;
		this.cells = new Cell[rows][cols];
		for (int r = 0; r < rows; r++) {
			System.arraycopy(cells[r], 0, this.cells[r], 0, cols);
		}
		TerminationCell foundSource = null;
		TerminationCell foundSink = null;
		int sourceCount = 0;
		int sinkCount = 0;
		for (int r = 0; r < rows; r++) {

				if (cell instanceof TerminationCell) {
					TerminationCell termCell = (TerminationCell) cell;
					if (termCell.isSource()) {
						sourceCount++;
						if (r == 0 || r == rows - 1 || c == 0 || c == cols - 1) {
							throw new IllegalArgumentException("Source cannot be on the edge");
						}
						Direction dir = termCell.getDirection();
						Coordinate targetCoord = new Coordinate(r, c).add(dir.getOffset());
						if (isWithinBounds(targetCoord) && cells[targetCoord.row][targetCoord.col] instanceof Wall) {
							throw new IllegalArgumentException("Source cannot point into a wall");
						}
						foundSource = termCell;
					} else if (termCell.isSink()) {
						sinkCount++;
						if (!(r == 0 || r == rows - 1 || c == 0 || c == cols - 1)) {
							throw new IllegalArgumentException("Sink must be on the edge");
						}
						Direction dir = termCell.getDirection();
						Coordinate targetCoord = new Coordinate(r, c).add(dir.getOffset());
						if (isWithinBounds(targetCoord)) {
							throw new IllegalArgumentException("Sink must point outside the map");
						}
						foundSink = termCell;
					}
				}
			}
		}
		if (sourceCount != 1) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("Exactly one source cell required");
		}
		if (sinkCount != 1) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("Exactly one sink cell required");
		}
		this.sourceCell = foundSource;

	public void undo(final Coordinate coord) {
		int row = coord.row;

	public void fillTiles(int distance) {
		if (sourceCell == null || cells == null || rows == 0 || cols == 0) {
			return;
		}
		filledTiles.clear();
		Queue<CoordinateDistance> queue = new ArrayDeque<>();
		queue.add(new CoordinateDistance(sourceCell.getCoordinate(), 0));
		filledTiles.add(sourceCell.getCoordinate());
		while (!queue.isEmpty()) {
			CoordinateDistance current = queue.poll();
			int currentDist = current.distance;
			if (currentDist >= distance) {
				continue;
			}
			for (Direction dir : Direction.values()) {
				Coordinate neighbor = current.coord.add(dir.getOffset());
				if (isWithinBounds(neighbor) && !filledTiles.contains(neighbor)) {
					Cell cell = cells[neighbor.row][neighbor.col];
					if (cell instanceof FillableCell) {
```

public boolean checkPath() {
    if (sourceCell == null || sinkCell == null) {
        return false;
    }

    Set<Coordinate> visited = new HashSet<>();
    Queue<Coordinate> queue = new ArrayDeque<>();
    Coordinate start = sourceCell.getCoordinate();
    queue.add(start);
    visited.add(start);

    while (!queue.isEmpty()) {
        Coordinate current = queue.poll();

        // Check if we've reached the sink
        if (current.equals(sinkCell.getCoordinate())) {
            return true;
        }

        Cell currentCell = cells[current.row][current.col];

        // If current cell is source or contains a pipe, explore neighbors
        if (currentCell instanceof TerminationCell || currentCell instanceof Pipe) {
            // For each direction, check if movement is possible
            for (Direction dir : Direction.values()) {
                Coordinate neighbor = current.add(dir.getOffset());

                if (!isWithinBounds(neighbor) || visited.contains(neighbor)) {
                    continue;
                }

                Cell neighborCell = cells[neighbor.row][neighbor.col];

                // Only proceed if neighbor is not a wall and is connectable
                if (neighborCell instanceof FillableCell || neighborCell instanceof TerminationCell) {
                    // Check if the pipe or cell at neighbor allows entry from current direction
                    boolean canEnter = false;

                    if (neighborCell instanceof TerminationCell) {
                        // For sink, check if direction matches sink's entry direction
                        TerminationCell sink = (TerminationCell) neighborCell;
                        if (neighbor.equals(sink.getCoordinate()) && sink.getDirection() == dir.getOpposite()) {
                            canEnter = true;
                        }
                    } else if (neighborCell instanceof Pipe) {
                        Pipe pipe = (Pipe) neighborCell;
                        // Check if pipe allows entry from current direction
                        if (pipe.allowsEntryFrom(dir.getOpposite())) {
                            // Also check if pipe allows exit in the direction from current cell
                            if (pipe.allowsExitTo(dir)) {
                                canEnter = true;
                            }
                        }
                    }

                    if (canEnter) {
                        visited.add(neighbor);
                        queue.add(neighbor);
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
    return false;

Response Text:---
The `hasLost()` method should determine whether the game is lost based on whether any pipes were filled during the last round. According to the hint, the game is lost if no pipes are filled during a round, which can be checked by comparing the number of filled tiles before and after the round.

A typical approach is:
- Keep track of the number of filled tiles at the start of the round (`prevFilledTiles`).
- After the round, check if the number of filled tiles has increased.
- If it hasn't increased, it means no new tiles were filled, so the game is lost.

Here's a complete implementation:

```java
public boolean hasLost() {
    int currentFilledCount = filledTiles.size();
    boolean noNewTilesFilled = currentFilledCount == prevFilledTiles;
    // Update prevFilledTiles for the next round
    prevFilledTiles = currentFilledCount;
    return noNewTilesFilled;
}
```

This method compares the current count of filled tiles with the previous count. If they are equal, no new tiles were filled during the last round, indicating the game is lost. It then updates `prevFilledTiles` for subsequent calls.

```java
package game.map;

import game.map.cells.Cell;
import game.map.cells.FillableCell;
import game.map.cells.TerminationCell;

import game.pipes.Pipe;
import io.Deserializer;
import org.jetbrains.annotations.NotNull;
import util.Coordinate;

import util.StringUtils;

/**
 * Map of the game.
 */
public class Map {

	private final int rows;
	private final int cols;
	@NotNull
	final Cell[][] cells;

	private TerminationCell sourceCell;
	private TerminationCell sinkCell;

	@NotNull
	private final Set<Coordinate> filledTiles = new HashSet<>();
	private int prevFilledTiles = 0;
	private Integer prevFilledDistance;

	/**
	 * Constructs a map from a map string.
	 * <p>
	 * This is a convenience method for unit testing.
	 * </p>
	 *
	 * @param rows     Number of rows.
	 * @param cols     Number of columns.
	 * @param cellsRep String representation of the map, with columns delimited by {@code '\n'}.
	 * @return A map with the cells set from {@code cellsRep}.
	 * @throws IllegalArgumentException If the map is incorrectly formatted.
	 */
	@NotNull
	static Map fromString(int rows, int cols, @NotNull String cellsRep) {
		var cells = Deserializer.parseString(rows, cols, cellsRep);

		return new Map(rows, cols, cells);
	}

	/**
	 * Tries to place a pipe at (row, col).
	 *
	 * @param coord Coordinate to place pipe at.
	 * @param pipe  Pipe to place in cell.
	 * @return {@code true} if the pipe is placed in the cell, {@code false} otherwise.
	 */
	public boolean tryPlacePipe(@NotNull final Coordinate coord, @NotNull final Pipe pipe) {
		return tryPlacePipe(coord.row, coord.col, pipe);
	}

	@NotNull
	private TerminationCell.CreateInfo generateStartCellInfo() {
		Random rng = new Random();

		Coordinate coord;
		Direction direction;

		do {
			int row = rng.nextInt(rows);
			int col = rng.nextInt(cols);
			coord = new Coordinate(row, col);

			int dir = rng.nextInt(4);
			direction = Direction.values()[dir];

			if (row == 0 || row == rows - 1) {
				continue;
			}
			if (col == 0 || col == cols - 1) {
				continue;
			}
			switch (direction) {
			case UP:
				if (row <= 1) {
					continue;
				}
				break;
			case DOWN:
				if (row >= rows - 2) {
					continue;
				}
				break;
			case LEFT:
				if (col <= 1) {
					continue;
				}
				break;
			case RIGHT:
				if (col >= cols - 2) {
					continue;
				}
				break;
			}

			break;
		} while (true);

		return new TerminationCell.CreateInfo(coord, direction);
	}

	@NotNull
	private TerminationCell.CreateInfo generateEndCellInfo() {
		Random rng = new Random();

		Coordinate coord;
		Direction direction;

		do {
			// false -> X-axis, true -> Y-axis
			boolean axisToClamp = rng.nextInt(2) == 1;
			int row = axisToClamp ? (rng.nextInt(2) == 1 ? rows - 1 : 0) : rng.nextInt(rows - 2) + 1;
			int col = !axisToClamp ? (rng.nextInt(2) == 1 ? cols - 1 : 0) : rng.nextInt(cols - 2) + 1;

			if (row == col) {
				continue;
			}

			coord = new Coordinate(row, col);

			if (axisToClamp) {
				if (row == 0) {
					direction = Direction.UP;
				} else {
					direction = Direction.DOWN;
				}
			} else {
				if (col == 0) {
					direction = Direction.LEFT;
				} else {
					direction = Direction.RIGHT;
				}
			}

			var adjacentCell = coord.add(direction.getOpposite().getOffset());
			if (adjacentCell.equals(sourceCell.coord)) {
				continue;
			}

			break;
		} while (true);

		return new TerminationCell.CreateInfo(coord, direction);
	}

	/**
	 * Displays the current map.

	public void display() {
		final int padLength = Integer.valueOf(rows - 1).toString().length();

		Runnable printColumns = () -> {
			System.out.print(StringUtils.createPadding(padLength, ' '));
			System.out.print(' ');
			for (int i = 0; i < cols - 2; ++i) {
				System.out.print((char) ('A' + i));
			}
			System.out.println();
		};

		printColumns.run();

		for (int i = 0; i < rows; ++i) {
			if (i != 0 && i != rows - 1) {
				System.out.print(String.format("%1$" + padLength + "s", i));
			} else {
				System.out.print(StringUtils.createPadding(padLength, ' '));
			}

			Arrays.stream(cells[i]).forEachOrdered(elem -> System.out.print(elem.toSingleChar()));

			if (i != 0 && i != rows - 1) {
				System.out.print(i);
			}

			System.out.println();
		}

		printColumns.run();
	}

		sourceCell.setFilled();
	}

	public void Map(int rows, int cols) {
		this.rows = rows;
		this.cols = cols;
		this.cells = new Cell[rows][cols];
		for (int r = 0; r < rows; r++) {
			for (int c = 0; c < cols; c++) {
				cells[r][c] = new FillableCell();
			}
		}
		TerminationCell.CreateInfo sourceInfo = generateStartCellInfo();
		sourceCell = new TerminationCell(sourceInfo.coord, sourceInfo.direction);
		cells[sourceInfo.coord.row][sourceInfo.coord.col] = sourceCell;
		TerminationCell.CreateInfo sinkInfo = generateEndCellInfo();
		sinkCell = new TerminationCell(sinkInfo.coord, sinkInfo.direction);
		cells[sinkInfo.coord.row][sinkInfo.coord.col] = sinkCell;
	}

	public void Map(int rows, int cols, Cell[][] cells) {
		this.rows = rows;
		this.cols = cols;
		this.cells = new Cell[rows][cols];
		for (int r = 0; r < rows; r++) {
			System.arraycopy(cells[r], 0, this.cells[r], 0, cols);
		}
		TerminationCell foundSource = null;
		TerminationCell foundSink = null;
		int sourceCount = 0;
		int sinkCount = 0;
		for (int r = 0; r < rows; r++) {
			for (int c = 0; c < cols; c++) {
				Cell cell = this.cells[r][c];
				if (cell instanceof TerminationCell) {
					TerminationCell termCell = (TerminationCell) cell;
					if (termCell.isSource()) {
						sourceCount++;
						if (r == 0 || r == rows - 1 || c == 0 || c == cols - 1) {
							throw new IllegalArgumentException("Source cannot be on the edge");
						}
						Direction dir = termCell.getDirection();
						Coordinate targetCoord = new Coordinate(r, c).add(dir.getOffset());
						if (isWithinBounds(targetCoord) && cells[targetCoord.row][targetCoord.col] instanceof Wall) {
							throw new IllegalArgumentException("Source cannot point into a wall");
						}
						foundSource = termCell;
					} else if (termCell.isSink()) {
						sinkCount++;
						if (!(r == 0 || r == rows - 1 || c == 0 || c == cols - 1)) {
							throw new IllegalArgumentException("Sink must be on the edge");
						}
						Direction dir = termCell.getDirection();
						Coordinate targetCoord = new Coordinate(r, c).add(dir.getOffset());
						if (isWithinBounds(targetCoord)) {
							throw new IllegalArgumentException("Sink must point outside the map");
						}
						foundSink = termCell;
					}
				}
			}
		}
		if (sourceCount != 1) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("Exactly one source cell required");
		}
		if (sinkCount != 1) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("Exactly one sink cell required");
		}
		this.sourceCell = foundSource;
		this.sinkCell = foundSink;
	}

	boolean tryPlacePipe(int row, int col, Pipe p) {
		int r = row - 1;
		int c = col - 1;
		if (r < 0 || r >= rows || c < 0 || c >= cols) {
			return false;
		}
		Cell targetCell = cells[r][c];
		if (!(targetCell instanceof FillableCell)) {
			return false;
		}
		FillableCell fillable = (FillableCell) targetCell;
		if (fillable.isOccupied()) {
			return false;
		}
		fillable.setPipe(p);
		return true;
	}

	public void undo(final Coordinate coord) {
		int row = coord.row;
		int col = coord.col;
		if (!isWithinBounds(coord)) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("Coordinate out of bounds");
		}
		Cell currentCell = cells[row][col];
		if (!(currentCell instanceof FillableCell)) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("Cell is not fillable");
		}
		cells[row][col] = new FillableCell();
	}

	public void fillTiles(int distance) {
		if (sourceCell == null || cells == null || rows == 0 || cols == 0) {
			return;
		}
		filledTiles.clear();
		Queue<CoordinateDistance> queue = new ArrayDeque<>();
		queue.add(new CoordinateDistance(sourceCell.getCoordinate(), 0));
		filledTiles.add(sourceCell.getCoordinate());
		while (!queue.isEmpty()) {
			CoordinateDistance current = queue.poll();
			int currentDist = current.distance;
			if (currentDist >= distance) {
				continue;
			}
			for (Direction dir : Direction.values()) {
				Coordinate neighbor = current.coord.add(dir.getOffset());
				if (isWithinBounds(neighbor) && !filledTiles.contains(neighbor)) {
					Cell cell = cells[neighbor.row][neighbor.col];
					if (cell instanceof FillableCell) {
						((FillableCell) cell).setFilled();
						filledTiles.add(neighbor);
						queue.add(new CoordinateDistance(neighbor, currentDist + 1));
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}

	public boolean checkPath() {
		if (sourceCell == null || sinkCell == null) {
			return false;
		}
		Set<Coordinate> visited = new HashSet<>();
		Queue<Coordinate> queue = new ArrayDeque<>();
		Coordinate start = sourceCell.getCoordinate();
		queue.add(start);
		visited.add(start);
		while (!queue.isEmpty()) {
			Coordinate current = queue.poll();
			if (current.equals(sinkCell.getCoordinate())) {
				return true;
			}
			Cell currentCell = cells[current.row][current.col];
			if (currentCell instanceof TerminationCell || currentCell instanceof Pipe) {
				for (Direction dir : Direction.values()) {
					Coordinate neighbor = current.add(dir.getOffset());
					if (!isWithinBounds(neighbor) || visited.contains(neighbor)) {
						continue;
					}
					Cell neighborCell = cells[neighbor.row][neighbor.col];
					if (neighborCell instanceof FillableCell || neighborCell instanceof TerminationCell) {
						boolean canEnter = false;
						if (neighborCell instanceof TerminationCell) {
							TerminationCell sink = (TerminationCell) neighborCell;
							if (neighbor.equals(sink.getCoordinate()) && sink.getDirection() == dir.getOpposite()) {
								canEnter = true;
							}
						} else if (neighborCell instanceof Pipe) {
							Pipe pipe = (Pipe) neighborCell;
							if (pipe.allowsEntryFrom(dir.getOpposite())) {
								if (pipe.allowsExitTo(dir)) {
									canEnter = true;
								}
							}
						}
						if (canEnter) {
							visited.add(neighbor);
							queue.add(neighbor);
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}
		return false;
	}
}
```

```java
import game.map.cells.Cell;

import game.pipes.Pipe;
import io.Deserializer;
import org.jetbrains.annotations.NotNull;
import util.Coordinate;
import util.Direction;
import util.StringUtils;

import java.util.*;

/**
 * Map of the game.
 */
public class Map {

	private final int rows;
	private final int cols;
	@NotNull
	final Cell[][] cells;

	private TerminationCell sourceCell;
	private TerminationCell sinkCell;

	@NotNull
	private final Set<Coordinate> filledTiles = new HashSet<>();
	private int prevFilledTiles = 0;
	private Integer prevFilledDistance;

	/**
	 * Constructs a map from a map string.
	 * <p>
	 * This is a convenience method for unit testing.
	 * </p>
	 *
	 * @param rows     Number of rows.
	 * @param cols     Number of columns.
	 * @param cellsRep String representation of the map, with columns delimited by {@code '\n'}.
	 * @return A map with the cells set from {@code cellsRep}.
	 * @throws IllegalArgumentException If the map is incorrectly formatted.
	 */
	@NotNull
	static Map fromString(int rows, int cols, @NotNull String cellsRep) {
		var cells = Deserializer.parseString(rows, cols, cellsRep);

		return new Map(rows, cols, cells);
	}

	/**
	 * Tries to place a pipe at (row, col).
	 *
	 * @param coord Coordinate to place pipe at.
	 * @param pipe  Pipe to place in cell.
	 * @return {@code true} if the pipe is placed in the cell, {@code false} otherwise.
	 */
	public boolean tryPlacePipe(@NotNull final Coordinate coord, @NotNull final Pipe pipe) {
		return tryPlacePipe(coord.row, coord.col, pipe);
	}

	@NotNull
	private TerminationCell.CreateInfo generateStartCellInfo() {
		Random rng = new Random();

		Coordinate coord;
		Direction direction;

		do {
			int row = rng.nextInt(rows);
			int col = rng.nextInt(cols);
			coord = new Coordinate(row, col);

			int dir = rng.nextInt(4);
			direction = Direction.values()[dir];

			if (row == 0 || row == rows - 1) {
				continue;
			}
			if (col == 0 || col == cols - 1) {
				continue;
			}
			switch (direction) {
			case UP:
				if (row <= 1) {
					continue;
				}
				break;
			case DOWN:
				if (row >= rows - 2) {
					continue;
				}
				break;
			case LEFT:
				if (col <= 1) {
					continue;
				}
				break;
			case RIGHT:
				if (col >= cols - 2) {
					continue;
				}
				break;
			}

			break;
		} while (true);

		return new TerminationCell.CreateInfo(coord, direction);
	}

	@NotNull
	private TerminationCell.CreateInfo generateEndCellInfo() {
		Random rng = new Random();

		Coordinate coord;
		Direction direction;

		do {
			// false -> X-axis, true -> Y-axis
			boolean axisToClamp = rng.nextInt(2) == 1;
			int row = axisToClamp ? (rng.nextInt(2) == 1 ? rows - 1 : 0) : rng.nextInt(rows - 2) + 1;
			int col = !axisToClamp ? (rng.nextInt(2) == 1 ? cols - 1 : 0) : rng.nextInt(cols - 2) + 1;

			if (row == col) {
				continue;
			}

			coord = new Coordinate(row, col);

			if (axisToClamp) {
				if (row == 0) {
					direction = Direction.UP;
				} else {
					direction = Direction.DOWN;
				}
			} else {
				if (col == 0) {
					direction = Direction.LEFT;
				} else {
					direction = Direction.RIGHT;
				}
			}

			var adjacentCell = coord.add(direction.getOpposite().getOffset());
			if (adjacentCell.equals(sourceCell.coord)) {
				continue;
			}

			break;
		} while (true);

		return new TerminationCell.CreateInfo(coord, direction);
	}

	/**
	 * Displays the current map.
	 */
	public void display() {
		final int padLength = Integer.valueOf(rows - 1).toString().length();

		Runnable printColumns = () -> {
			System.out.print(StringUtils.createPadding(padLength, ' '));
			System.out.print(' ');
			for (int i = 0; i < cols - 2; ++i) {
				System.out.print((char) ('A' + i));
			}
			System.out.println();
		};

		printColumns.run();

		for (int i = 0; i < rows; ++i) {
			if (i != 0 && i != rows - 1) {
				System.out.print(String.format("%1$" + padLength + "s", i));
			} else {
				System.out.print(StringUtils.createPadding(padLength, ' '));
			}

			Arrays.stream(cells[i]).forEachOrdered(elem -> System.out.print(elem.toSingleChar()));

			if (i != 0 && i != rows - 1) {
				System.out.print(i);
			}

			System.out.println();
		}

		printColumns.run();
	}

	public void fillBeginTile() {
		sourceCell.setFilled();
	}

	@NotNull
	private List<Coordinate> getTraversedCoords() {
		return new ArrayList<>(filledTiles);
	}

	/**

	 * there a way to check whether pipes are filled during a round?

	 * @return {@code true} if the game is lost.

	public boolean hasLost() {
		// TODO

	public void Map(int rows, int cols) {
		this.rows = rows;
		this.cols = cols;
		this.cells = new Cell[rows][cols];
		for (int r = 0; r < rows; r++) {
			for (int c = 0; c < cols; c++) {
				cells[r][c] = new FillableCell();
			}
		}
		TerminationCell.CreateInfo sourceInfo = generateStartCellInfo();
		sourceCell = new TerminationCell(sourceInfo.coord, sourceInfo.direction);
		cells[sourceInfo.coord.row][sourceInfo.coord.col] = sourceCell;
		TerminationCell.CreateInfo sinkInfo = generateEndCellInfo();
		sinkCell = new TerminationCell(sinkInfo.coord, sinkInfo.direction);
		cells[sinkInfo.coord.row][sinkInfo.coord.col] = sinkCell;
	}

	public void Map(int rows, int cols, Cell[][] cells) {
		this.rows = rows;
		this.cols = cols;
		this.cells = new Cell[rows][cols];
		for (int r = 0; r < rows; r++) {
			System.arraycopy(cells[r], 0, this.cells[r], 0, cols);
		}
		TerminationCell foundSource = null;
		TerminationCell foundSink = null;
		int sourceCount = 0;
		int sinkCount = 0;
		for (int r = 0; r < rows; r++) {
			for (int c = 0; c < cols; c++) {
				Cell cell = this.cells[r][c];
				if (cell instanceof TerminationCell) {
					TerminationCell termCell = (TerminationCell) cell;
					if (termCell.isSource()) {
						sourceCount++;
						if (r == 0 || r == rows - 1 || c == 0 || c == cols - 1) {
							throw new IllegalArgumentException("Source cannot be on the edge");
						}
						Direction dir = termCell.getDirection();
						Coordinate targetCoord = new Coordinate(r, c).add(dir.getOffset());
						if (isWithinBounds(targetCoord) && cells[targetCoord.row][targetCoord.col] instanceof Wall) {
							throw new IllegalArgumentException("Source cannot point into a wall");
						}
						foundSource = termCell;
					} else if (termCell.isSink()) {
						sinkCount++;
						if (!(r == 0 || r == rows - 1 || c == 0 || c == cols - 1)) {
							throw new IllegalArgumentException("Sink must be on the edge");
						}
						Direction dir = termCell.getDirection();
						Coordinate targetCoord = new Coordinate(r, c).add(dir.getOffset());
						if (isWithinBounds(targetCoord)) {
							throw new IllegalArgumentException("Sink must point outside the map");
						}
						foundSink = termCell;
					}
				}
			}
		}
		if (sourceCount != 1) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("Exactly one source cell required");
		}
		if (sinkCount != 1) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("Exactly one sink cell required");
		}
		this.sourceCell = foundSource;
		this.sinkCell = foundSink;
	}

	boolean tryPlacePipe(int row, int col, Pipe p) {
		int r = row - 1;
		int c = col - 1;
		if (r < 0 || r >= rows || c < 0 || c >= cols) {
			return false;
		}
		Cell targetCell = cells[r][c];
		if (!(targetCell instanceof FillableCell)) {
			return false;
		}
		FillableCell fillable = (FillableCell) targetCell;
		if (fillable.isOccupied()) {
			return false;
		}
		fillable.setPipe(p);
		return true;
	}

	public void undo(final Coordinate coord) {
		int row = coord.row;
		int col = coord.col;
		if (!isWithinBounds(coord)) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("Coordinate out of bounds");
		}
		Cell currentCell = cells[row][col];
		if (!(currentCell instanceof FillableCell)) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("Cell is not fillable");
		}
		cells[row][col] = new FillableCell();
	}

	public void fillTiles(int distance) {
		if (sourceCell == null || cells == null || rows == 0 || cols == 0) {
			return;
		}
		filledTiles.clear();
		Queue<CoordinateDistance> queue = new ArrayDeque<>();
		queue.add(new CoordinateDistance(sourceCell.getCoordinate(), 0));
		filledTiles.add(sourceCell.getCoordinate());
		while (!queue.isEmpty()) {
			CoordinateDistance current = queue.poll();
			int currentDist = current.distance;
			if (currentDist >= distance) {
				continue;
			}
			for (Direction dir : Direction.values()) {
				Coordinate neighbor = current.coord.add(dir.getOffset());
				if (isWithinBounds(neighbor) && !filledTiles.contains(neighbor)) {
					Cell cell = cells[neighbor.row][neighbor.col];
					if (cell instanceof FillableCell) {
						((FillableCell) cell).setFilled();
						filledTiles.add(neighbor);
						queue.add(new CoordinateDistance(neighbor, currentDist + 1));
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}

	public boolean checkPath() {
		if (sourceCell == null || sinkCell == null) {
			return false;
		}
		Set<Coordinate> visited = new HashSet<>();
		Queue<Coordinate> queue = new ArrayDeque<>();
		Coordinate start = sourceCell.getCoordinate();
		queue.add(start);
		visited.add(start);
		while (!queue.isEmpty()) {
			Coordinate current = queue.poll();
			if (current.equals(sinkCell.getCoordinate())) {
				return true;
			}
			Cell currentCell = cells[current.row][current.col];
			if (currentCell instanceof TerminationCell || currentCell instanceof Pipe) {
				for (Direction dir : Direction.values()) {
					Coordinate neighbor = current.add(dir.getOffset());
					if (!isWithinBounds(neighbor) || visited.contains(neighbor)) {
						continue;
					}
					Cell neighborCell = cells[neighbor.row][neighbor.col];
					if (neighborCell instanceof FillableCell || neighborCell instanceof TerminationCell) {
						boolean canEnter = false;
						if (neighborCell instanceof TerminationCell) {
							TerminationCell sink = (TerminationCell) neighborCell;
							if (neighbor.equals(sink.getCoordinate()) && sink.getDirection() == dir.getOpposite()) {
								canEnter = true;
							}
						} else if (neighborCell instanceof Pipe) {
							Pipe pipe = (Pipe) neighborCell;
							if (pipe.allowsEntryFrom(dir.getOpposite())) {
								if (pipe.allowsExitTo(dir)) {
									canEnter = true;
								}
							}
						}
						if (canEnter) {
							visited.add(neighbor);
							queue.add(neighbor);
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}
		return false;
	}
}
```

```java
public class Map {
    private final int rows;
    private final int cols;
    @NotNull
    final Cell[][] cells;

     * Constructor that initializes an empty map with given rows and columns.

        this.cols = cols;
        this.cells = new Cell[rows][cols];
        for (int r = 0; r < rows; r++) {
            for (int c = 0; c < cols; c++) {

            }
```
