Response Text:---
The `processAction` method is responsible for handling different user actions in the Sokoban game, such as move, undo, or exit. It should interpret the `action` parameter, perform the corresponding game logic, and return an `ActionResult` indicating success or failure.

Here's a brief explanation of how to implement it:
- Check the type of `action` using `instanceof`.
- For `Move`, process the move (possibly using `processOneStepMove`).
- For `Undo`, handle undo logic, considering quota and game state.
- For `Exit`, mark the game as finished.
- For unrecognized actions, return an invalid input result.

Below is a complete implementation of the `processAction` method:

```java
protected ActionResult processAction(Action action) {
    if (action instanceof Exit) {
        this.isExitSpecified = true;
        return new ActionResult.Success(action);
    } else if (action instanceof Undo) {
        if (this.state.canUndo()) {
            this.state.undo();
            return new ActionResult.Success(action);
        } else {
            return new ActionResult.Failed(action, UNDO_QUOTA_RUN_OUT);
        }
    } else if (action instanceof Move move) {
        Position playerPosition = this.state.getPlayerPosition(move.getInitiator());
        if (playerPosition == null) {
            return new ActionResult.Failed(move, PLAYER_NOT_FOUND);
        }
        return processOneStepMove(playerPosition, move);
    } else {
        return new ActionResult.Invalid(action);
    }
}
```

This implementation covers the main action types and ensures the game state is updated accordingly.

The `parse` method needs to process the input string, extract the undo limit, validate it, then parse each subsequent line to build the game map entities, track players, boxes, destinations, and ensure all constraints are met. Here's a complete implementation:

```java
public static GameMap parse(String mapText) {
    if (mapText == null || mapText.isEmpty()) {
        throw new IllegalArgumentException("Map text cannot be null or empty");
    }

    String[] lines = mapText.lines().toArray(String[]::new);
    if (lines.length < 2) {
        throw new IllegalArgumentException("Map must contain at least undo limit and one map line");
    }

    // Parse undo limit from the first line
    int undoLimit;
    try {
        undoLimit = Integer.parseInt(lines[0].trim());
    } catch (NumberFormatException e) {
        throw new IllegalArgumentException("Invalid undo limit format");
    }

    if (undoLimit < -1) {
        throw new IllegalArgumentException("Undo limit cannot be less than -1");
    }

    int height = lines.length - 1;
    int width = lines[1].length();

    // Validate all lines have the same length
    for (int i = 2; i <= height; i++) {
        if (lines[i].length() != width) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("All map lines must have the same length");
        }
    }

    Set<Position> destinations = new HashSet<>();
    Map<Position, Entity> mapEntities = new HashMap<>();
    Map<Character, Position> playersPositions = new HashMap<>();
    Map<Character, Box> boxesMap = new HashMap<>();
    Set<Character> playerIds = new HashSet<>();
    List<Box> boxes = new ArrayList<>();
    List<Player> players = new ArrayList<>();

    for (int y = 0; y < height; y++) {
        String line = lines[y + 1];
        for (int x = 0; x < width; x++) {
            char ch = line.charAt(x);
            Position pos = new Position(x, y);
            switch (ch) {
                case '#':
                    mapEntities.put(pos, new Wall());
                    break;
                case '@':
                    destinations.add(pos);
                    mapEntities.put(pos, new Empty()); // or keep as Empty
                    break;
                case '.':
                    mapEntities.put(pos, new Empty());
                    break;
                default:
                    if (Character.isUpperCase(ch)) {
                        // Player
                        if (playersPositions.containsKey(ch)) {
                            throw new IllegalArgumentException("Multiple players with same ID: " + ch);
                        }
                        Player player = new Player(ch - 'A' + 1); // assuming Player constructor takes id
                        players.add(player);
                        playersPositions.put(ch, pos);
                        mapEntities.put(pos, player);
                        playerIds.add(ch - 'A' + 1);
                    } else if (Character.isLowerCase(ch)) {
                        // Box
                        char upper = Character.toUpperCase(ch);
                        Box box = new Box(upper - 'A' + 1);
                        boxes.add(box);
                        mapEntities.put(pos, box);
                        boxesMap.put(ch, box);
                        // Assign box to player id
                        box.setPlayerId(upper - 'A' + 1);
                    } else {
                        // Unexpected character
                        throw new IllegalArgumentException("Invalid character in map: " + ch);
                    }
            }
        }
    }

    // Validation: at least one player
    if (players.isEmpty()) {
        throw new IllegalArgumentException("No players found in the map");
    }

    // Validate boxes and destinations count
    long boxCount = boxes.size();
    long destinationCount = destinations.size();
    if (boxCount != destinationCount) {
        throw new IllegalArgumentException("Number of boxes (" + boxCount + ") does not match number of destinations (" + destinationCount + ")");
    }

    // Validate boxes' player IDs exist
    for (Box box : boxes) {
        if (!playerIds.contains(box.getPlayerId())) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("Box with playerId " + box.getPlayerId() + " has no corresponding player");
        }
    }

    // Validate players have boxes
    Set<Integer> playersWithBoxes = boxes.stream().map(Box::getPlayerId).collect(Collectors.toSet());
    for (Player p : players) {
        if (!playersWithBoxes.contains(p.getId())) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("Player " + p.getId() + " has no boxes");
        }
    }

    // Build GameMap
    GameMap gameMap = new GameMap(width, height, destinations, undoLimit);
    // Put entities into the map
    for (Map.Entry<Position, Entity> entry : mapEntities.entrySet()) {
        gameMap.putEntity(entry.getKey(), entry.getValue());
    }

    return gameMap;
}
```

**Notes:**
- Assumes constructors for `Player` and `Box` accept an ID (int).
- Uses `Position` class with `x()` and `y()` methods.
- Throws `IllegalArgumentException` for all validation errors.
- Uses Java 19 features like `lines()` stream.

This implementation fully parses the string, validates constraints, and constructs the `GameMap` object accordingly.

public static GameMap parse(String mapText) {
    if (mapText == null || mapText.isEmpty()) {
        throw new IllegalArgumentException("Map text cannot be null or empty");
    }

    String[] lines = mapText.lines().toArray(String[]::new);
    if (lines.length < 2) {
        throw new IllegalArgumentException("Map must contain at least undo limit and one map line");
    }

    // Parse undo limit from the first line
    int undoLimit;
    try {
        undoLimit = Integer.parseInt(lines[0].trim());
    } catch (NumberFormatException e) {
        throw new IllegalArgumentException("Invalid undo limit format");
    }

    if (undoLimit < -1) {
        throw new IllegalArgumentException("Undo limit cannot be less than -1");
    }

    int height = lines.length - 1;
    int width = lines[1].length();

    // Validate all lines have the same length
    for (int i = 2; i <= height; i++) {
        if (lines[i].length() != width) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("All map lines must have the same length");
        }
    }

    Set<Position> destinations = new HashSet<>();
    Map<Position, Entity> mapEntities = new HashMap<>();
    Map<Character, Position> playersPositions = new HashMap<>();
    Map<Character, Box> boxesMap = new HashMap<>();
    Set<Character> playerIds = new HashSet<>();
    List<Box> boxes = new ArrayList<>();
    List<Player> players = new ArrayList<>();

    for (int y = 0; y < height; y++) {
        String line = lines[y + 1];
        for (int x = 0; x < width; x++) {
            char ch = line.charAt(x);
            Position pos = new Position(x, y);
            switch (ch) {
                case '#':
                    mapEntities.put(pos, new Wall());
                    break;
                case '@':
                    destinations.add(pos);
                    mapEntities.put(pos, new Empty()); // or keep as Empty
                    break;
                case '.':
                    mapEntities.put(pos, new Empty());
                    break;
                default:
                    if (Character.isUpperCase(ch)) {
                        // Player
                        if (playersPositions.containsKey(ch)) {
                            throw new IllegalArgumentException("Multiple players with same ID: " + ch);
                        }
                        Player player = new Player(ch - 'A' + 1); // assuming Player constructor takes id
                        players.add(player);
                        playersPositions.put(ch, pos);
                        mapEntities.put(pos, player);
                        playerIds.add(ch - 'A' + 1);
                    } else if (Character.isLowerCase(ch)) {
                        // Box
                        char upper = Character.toUpperCase(ch);
                        Box box = new Box(upper - 'A' + 1);
                        boxes.add(box);
                        mapEntities.put(pos, box);
                        boxesMap.put(ch, box);
                        // Assign box to player id
                        box.setPlayerId(upper - 'A' + 1);
                    } else {
                        // Unexpected character
                        throw new IllegalArgumentException("Invalid character in map: " + ch);
                    }
            }
        }
    }

    // Validation: at least one player
    if (players.isEmpty()) {
        throw new IllegalArgumentException("No players found in the map");
    }

    // Validate boxes and destinations count
    long boxCount = boxes.size();
    long destinationCount = destinations.size();
    if (boxCount != destinationCount) {
        throw new IllegalArgumentException("Number of boxes (" + boxCount + ") does not match number of destinations (" + destinationCount + ")");
    }

    // Validate boxes' player IDs exist
    for (Box box : boxes) {
        if (!playerIds.contains(box.getPlayerId())) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("Box with playerId " + box.getPlayerId() + " has no corresponding player");
        }
    }

    // Validate players have boxes
    Set<Integer> playersWithBoxes = boxes.stream().map(Box::getPlayerId).collect(Collectors.toSet());
    for (Player p : players) {
        if (!playersWithBoxes.contains(p.getId())) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("Player " + p.getId() + " has no boxes");
        }
    }

    // Build GameMap
    GameMap gameMap = new GameMap(width, height, destinations, undoLimit);
    // Put entities into the map
    for (Map.Entry<Position, Entity> entry : mapEntities.entrySet()) {
        gameMap.putEntity(entry.getKey(), entry.getValue());
    }

    return gameMap;

	public static GameMap parse(String mapText) {
		if (mapText == null || mapText.isEmpty()) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("Map text cannot be null or empty");
		}
		String[] lines = mapText.lines().toArray(String[]::new);
		if (lines.length < 2) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("Map must contain at least undo limit and one map line");
		}
		int undoLimit;
		try {
			undoLimit = Integer.parseInt(lines[0].trim());
		} catch (NumberFormatException e) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("Invalid undo limit format");
		}
		if (undoLimit < -1) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("Undo limit cannot be less than -1");
		}
		int height = lines.length - 1;
		int width = lines[1].length();
		for (int i = 2; i <= height; i++) {
			if (lines[i].length() != width) {
				throw new IllegalArgumentException("All map lines must have the same length");
			}
		}
		Set<Position> destinations = new HashSet<>();
		Map<Position, Entity> mapEntities = new HashMap<>();
		Map<Character, Position> playersPositions = new HashMap<>();
		Map<Character, Box> boxesMap = new HashMap<>();
		Set<Character> playerIds = new HashSet<>();
		List<Box> boxes = new ArrayList<>();
		List<Player> players = new ArrayList<>();
		for (int y = 0; y < height; y++) {
			String line = lines[y + 1];
			for (int x = 0; x < width; x++) {
				char ch = line.charAt(x);
				Position pos = new Position(x, y);
				switch (ch) {
				case '#':
					mapEntities.put(pos, new Wall());
					break;
				case '@':
					destinations.add(pos);
					mapEntities.put(pos, new Empty());
					break;
				case '.':
					mapEntities.put(pos, new Empty());
					break;
				default:
					if (Character.isUpperCase(ch)) {
						if (playersPositions.containsKey(ch)) {
							throw new IllegalArgumentException("Multiple players with same ID: " + ch);
						}
						Player player = new Player(ch - 'A' + 1);
						players.add(player);
						playersPositions.put(ch, pos);
						mapEntities.put(pos, player);
						playerIds.add(ch - 'A' + 1);
					} else if (Character.isLowerCase(ch)) {
						char upper = Character.toUpperCase(ch);
						Box box = new Box(upper - 'A' + 1);
						boxes.add(box);
						mapEntities.put(pos, box);
						boxesMap.put(ch, box);
						box.setPlayerId(upper - 'A' + 1);
					} else {
						throw new IllegalArgumentException("Invalid character in map: " + ch);
					}

	public static GameMap parse(String mapText) {
		if (mapText == null || mapText.isEmpty()) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("Map text cannot be null or empty");
		}
		String[] lines = mapText.lines().toArray(String[]::new);
		if (lines.length < 2) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("Map must contain at least undo limit and one map line");
		}
		int undoLimit;
		try {
			undoLimit = Integer.parseInt(lines[0].trim());
		} catch (NumberFormatException e) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("Invalid undo limit format");
		}
		if (undoLimit < -1) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("Undo limit cannot be less than -1");
		}
		int height = lines.length - 1;
		int width = lines[1].length();
		for (int i = 2; i <= height; i++) {
			if (lines[i].length() != width) {
				throw new IllegalArgumentException("All map lines must have the same length");
			}
		}
		Set<Position> destinations = new HashSet<>();
		Map<Position, Entity> mapEntities = new HashMap<>();
		Map<Character, Position> playersPositions = new HashMap<>();
		Map<Character, Box> boxesMap = new HashMap<>();
		Set<Character> playerIds = new HashSet<>();
		List<Box> boxes = new ArrayList<>();
		List<Player> players = new ArrayList<>();
		for (int y = 0; y < height; y++) {
			String line = lines[y + 1];
			for (int x = 0; x < width; x++) {
				char ch = line.charAt(x);
				Position pos = new Position(x, y);
				switch (ch) {
				case '#':
					mapEntities.put(pos, new Wall());
					break;
				case '@':
					destinations.add(pos);
					mapEntities.put(pos, new Empty());
					break;
				case '.':
					mapEntities.put(pos, new Empty());
					break;
				default:
					if (Character.isUpperCase(ch)) {
						if (playersPositions.containsKey(ch)) {
							throw new IllegalArgumentException("Multiple players with same ID: " + ch);
						}
						Player player = new Player(ch - 'A' + 1);
						players.add(player);
						playersPositions.put(ch, pos);
						mapEntities.put(pos, player);
						playerIds.add(ch - 'A' + 1);
					} else if (Character.isLowerCase(ch)) {
						char upper = Character.toUpperCase(ch);
						Box box = new Box(upper - 'A' + 1);
						boxes.add(box);
						mapEntities.put(pos, box);
						boxesMap.put(ch, box);
						box.setPlayerId(upper - 'A' + 1);
					} else {
						throw new IllegalArgumentException("Invalid character in map: " + ch);
					}
				}
			}
		}
		if (players.isEmpty()) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("No players found in the map");
		}
		long boxCount = boxes.size();
		long destinationCount = destinations.size();
		if (boxCount != destinationCount) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("Number of boxes (" + boxCount
					+ ") does not match number of destinations (" + destinationCount + ")");
		}
		for (Box box : boxes) {
			if (!playerIds.contains(box.getPlayerId())) {
				throw new IllegalArgumentException(
						"Box with playerId " + box.getPlayerId() + " has no corresponding player");
			}
		}
		Set<Integer> playersWithBoxes = boxes.stream().map(Box::getPlayerId).collect(Collectors.toSet());
		for (Player p : players) {
			if (!playersWithBoxes.contains(p.getId())) {
				throw new IllegalArgumentException("Player " + p.getId() + " has no boxes");
			}
		}
		GameMap gameMap = new GameMap(width, height, destinations, undoLimit);
		for (Map.Entry<Position, Entity> entry : mapEntities.entrySet()) {
			gameMap.putEntity(entry.getKey(), entry.getValue());
		}
		return gameMap;
	}

	public Entity getEntity(Position position) {
		return map.get(position);
	}
}

Since the `undoLimit` field is an `int` that can be -1 (unlimited), 0 (no undo), or positive, we need to wrap this value in an `Optional`. Typically, for clarity, we can return an empty `Optional` for unlimited, and a present value otherwise.

Here's a suitable implementation:

```java
public Optional<Integer> getUndoLimit() {
    if (undoLimit == -1) {
        return Optional.empty();
    } else {
        return Optional.of(undoLimit);
    }
}
```

This way, callers can interpret an empty `Optional` as unlimited undo actions, and a present value as the specific limit.

	public static GameMap parse(String mapText) {
		if (mapText == null || mapText.isEmpty()) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("Map text cannot be null or empty");
		}
		String[] lines = mapText.lines().toArray(String[]::new);
		if (lines.length < 2) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("Map must contain at least undo limit and one map line");
		}
		int undoLimit;
		try {
			undoLimit = Integer.parseInt(lines[0].trim());
		} catch (NumberFormatException e) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("Invalid undo limit format");
		}
		if (undoLimit < -1) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("Undo limit cannot be less than -1");
		}
		int height = lines.length - 1;
		int width = lines[1].length();
		for (int i = 2; i <= height; i++) {
			if (lines[i].length() != width) {
				throw new IllegalArgumentException("All map lines must have the same length");
			}
		}
		Set<Position> destinations = new HashSet<>();
		Map<Position, Entity> mapEntities = new HashMap<>();
		Map<Character, Position> playersPositions = new HashMap<>();
		Map<Character, Box> boxesMap = new HashMap<>();
		Set<Character> playerIds = new HashSet<>();
		List<Box> boxes = new ArrayList<>();
		List<Player> players = new ArrayList<>();
		for (int y = 0; y < height; y++) {
			String line = lines[y + 1];
			for (int x = 0; x < width; x++) {
				char ch = line.charAt(x);
				Position pos = new Position(x, y);
				switch (ch) {
				case '#':
					mapEntities.put(pos, new Wall());
					break;
				case '@':
					destinations.add(pos);
					mapEntities.put(pos, new Empty());
					break;
				case '.':
					mapEntities.put(pos, new Empty());
					break;
				default:
					if (Character.isUpperCase(ch)) {
						if (playersPositions.containsKey(ch)) {
							throw new IllegalArgumentException("Multiple players with same ID: " + ch);
						}
						Player player = new Player(ch - 'A' + 1);
						players.add(player);
						playersPositions.put(ch, pos);
						mapEntities.put(pos, player);
						playerIds.add(ch - 'A' + 1);
					} else if (Character.isLowerCase(ch)) {
						char upper = Character.toUpperCase(ch);
						Box box = new Box(upper - 'A' + 1);
						boxes.add(box);
						mapEntities.put(pos, box);
						boxesMap.put(ch, box);
						box.setPlayerId(upper - 'A' + 1);
					} else {
						throw new IllegalArgumentException("Invalid character in map: " + ch);
					}
				}
			}
		}
		if (players.isEmpty()) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("No players found in the map");
		}
		long boxCount = boxes.size();
		long destinationCount = destinations.size();
		if (boxCount != destinationCount) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("Number of boxes (" + boxCount
					+ ") does not match number of destinations (" + destinationCount + ")");
		}
		for (Box box : boxes) {
			if (!playerIds.contains(box.getPlayerId())) {
				throw new IllegalArgumentException(
						"Box with playerId " + box.getPlayerId() + " has no corresponding player");
			}
		}
		Set<Integer> playersWithBoxes = boxes.stream().map(Box::getPlayerId).collect(Collectors.toSet());
		for (Player p : players) {
			if (!playersWithBoxes.contains(p.getId())) {
				throw new IllegalArgumentException("Player " + p.getId() + " has no boxes");
			}
		}
		GameMap gameMap = new GameMap(width, height, destinations, undoLimit);
		for (Map.Entry<Position, Entity> entry : mapEntities.entrySet()) {
			gameMap.putEntity(entry.getKey(), entry.getValue());
		}
		return gameMap;
	}

	public Entity getEntity(Position position) {
		return map.get(position);
	}

	public void putEntity(Position position, Entity entity) {
		this.map.put(position, entity);
	}

	public Set<Position> getDestinations() {
		return destinations;
	}
}

- Filter those entities to include only instances of `Player`.

- Collect these IDs into a `Set<Integer>` to ensure uniqueness.

public Set<Integer> getPlayerIds() {

package assignment.game;

import assignment.actions.Move;
import assignment.entities.Box;
import assignment.entities.Empty;
import assignment.entities.Entity;
import assignment.entities.Player;
import assignment.entities.Wall;
import org.jetbrains.annotations.NotNull;
import org.jetbrains.annotations.Nullable;
import org.jetbrains.annotations.Unmodifiable;

import java.util.*;
import java.util.concurrent.atomic.AtomicInteger;
import java.util.stream.Collectors;

/**
 * A Sokoban game board.
 * GameBoard consists of information loaded from map data, such as
 * <li>Width and height of the game map</li>
 * <li>Walls in the map</li>
 * <li>Box destinations</li>
 * <li>Initial locations of boxes and player</li>
 * <p/>
 * GameBoard is capable to create many GameState instances, each representing an ongoing game.
 */
public class GameMap {

	private final Map<Position, Entity> map;

	private final int maxWidth;

	private final int maxHeight;

	private final Set<Position> destinations;

	private final int undoLimit;

	/**
	 * Create a new GameMap with width, height, set of box destinations and undo limit.
	 *
	 * @param maxWidth     Width of the game map.
	 * @param maxHeight    Height of the game map.
	 * @param destinations Set of box destination positions.
	 * @param undoLimit    Undo limit.
	 *                     Positive numbers specify the maximum number of undo actions.
	 *                     0 means undo is not allowed.
	 *                     -1 means unlimited. Other negative numbers are not allowed.
	 */
	public GameMap(int maxWidth, int maxHeight, Set<Position> destinations, int undoLimit) {
		this.maxWidth = maxWidth;
		this.maxHeight = maxHeight;
		this.destinations = Collections.unmodifiableSet(destinations);
		this.undoLimit = undoLimit;
		this.map = new HashMap<>();
	}

	private GameMap(Map<Position, Entity> map, Set<Position> destinations, int undoLimit) {
		this.map = Collections.unmodifiableMap(map);
		this.destinations = Collections.unmodifiableSet(destinations);
		this.undoLimit = undoLimit;
		this.maxWidth = map.keySet().stream().mapToInt(Position::x).max().orElse(0) + 1;
		this.maxHeight = map.keySet().stream().mapToInt(Position::y).max().orElse(0) + 1;
	}

	/**
	 * Get the maximum height of the game map.
	 *
	 * @return maximum height.
	 */
	public int getMaxHeight() {
		// TODO
		throw new NotImplementedException();
	}

	public static GameMap parse(String mapText) {
		if (mapText == null || mapText.isEmpty()) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("Map text cannot be null or empty");
		}
		String[] lines = mapText.lines().toArray(String[]::new);
		if (lines.length < 2) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("Map must contain at least undo limit and one map line");
		}
		int undoLimit;
		try {
			undoLimit = Integer.parseInt(lines[0].trim());
		} catch (NumberFormatException e) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("Invalid undo limit format");
		}
		if (undoLimit < -1) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("Undo limit cannot be less than -1");
		}
		int height = lines.length - 1;
		int width = lines[1].length();
		for (int i = 2; i <= height; i++) {
			if (lines[i].length() != width) {
				throw new IllegalArgumentException("All map lines must have the same length");
			}
		}
		Set<Position> destinations = new HashSet<>();
		Map<Position, Entity> mapEntities = new HashMap<>();
		Map<Character, Position> playersPositions = new HashMap<>();
		Map<Character, Box> boxesMap = new HashMap<>();
		Set<Character> playerIds = new HashSet<>();
		List<Box> boxes = new ArrayList<>();
		List<Player> players = new ArrayList<>();
		for (int y = 0; y < height; y++) {
			String line = lines[y + 1];
			for (int x = 0; x < width; x++) {
				char ch = line.charAt(x);
				Position pos = new Position(x, y);
				switch (ch) {
				case '#':
					mapEntities.put(pos, new Wall());
					break;
				case '@':
					destinations.add(pos);
					mapEntities.put(pos, new Empty());
					break;
				case '.':
					mapEntities.put(pos, new Empty());
					break;
				default:
					if (Character.isUpperCase(ch)) {
						if (playersPositions.containsKey(ch)) {
							throw new IllegalArgumentException("Multiple players with same ID: " + ch);
						}
						Player player = new Player(ch - 'A' + 1);
						players.add(player);
						playersPositions.put(ch, pos);
						mapEntities.put(pos, player);
						playerIds.add(ch - 'A' + 1);
					} else if (Character.isLowerCase(ch)) {
						char upper = Character.toUpperCase(ch);
						Box box = new Box(upper - 'A' + 1);
						boxes.add(box);
						mapEntities.put(pos, box);
						boxesMap.put(ch, box);
						box.setPlayerId(upper - 'A' + 1);
					} else {
						throw new IllegalArgumentException("Invalid character in map: " + ch);
					}
				}
			}
		}
		if (players.isEmpty()) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("No players found in the map");
		}
		long boxCount = boxes.size();
		long destinationCount = destinations.size();
		if (boxCount != destinationCount) {
			throw new IllegalArgumentException("Number of boxes (" + boxCount
					+ ") does not match number of destinations (" + destinationCount + ")");
		}
		for (Box box : boxes) {
			if (!playerIds.contains(box.getPlayerId())) {
				throw new IllegalArgumentException(
						"Box with playerId " + box.getPlayerId() + " has no corresponding player");
			}
		}
		Set<Integer> playersWithBoxes = boxes.stream().map(Box::getPlayerId).collect(Collectors.toSet());
		for (Player p : players) {
			if (!playersWithBoxes.contains(p.getId())) {
				throw new IllegalArgumentException("Player " + p.getId() + " has no boxes");
			}
		}
		GameMap gameMap = new GameMap(width, height, destinations, undoLimit);
		for (Map.Entry<Position, Entity> entry : mapEntities.entrySet()) {
			gameMap.putEntity(entry.getKey(), entry.getValue());
		}
		return gameMap;
	}

	public Entity getEntity(Position position) {
		return map.get(position);
	}

	public void putEntity(Position position, Entity entity) {
		this.map.put(position, entity);
	}

	public Set<Position> getDestinations() {
		return destinations;
	}

	public Optional<Integer> getUndoLimit() {
		if (undoLimit == -1) {
			return Optional.empty();
		} else {
			return Optional.of(undoLimit);
		}
	}

	public Set<Integer> getPlayerIds() {
		return map.values().stream().filter(entity -> entity instanceof Player).map(entity -> ((Player) entity).getId())
				.collect(Collectors.toSet());
	}

	public int getMaxWidth() {
		return maxWidth;
	}
}

		for (Player p : players) {
			if (!playersWithBoxes.contains(p.getId())) {
				throw new IllegalArgumentException("Player " + p.getId() + " has no boxes");
			}
		}
		GameMap gameMap = new GameMap(width, height, destinations, undoLimit);
		for (Map.Entry<Position, Entity> entry : mapEntities.entrySet()) {
			gameMap.putEntity(entry.getKey(), entry.getValue());
		}
		return gameMap;
	}

	public Entity getEntity(Position position) {
		return map.get(position);
	}

	public void putEntity(Position position, Entity entity) {
		this.map.put(position, entity);
	}

	public Set<Position> getDestinations() {
		return destinations;
	}

	public Optional<Integer> getUndoLimit() {
		if (undoLimit == -1) {
			return Optional.empty();
		} else {
			return Optional.of(undoLimit);
		}
	}

	public Set<Integer> getPlayerIds() {
		return map.values().stream().filter(entity -> entity instanceof Player).map(entity -> ((Player) entity).getId())
				.collect(Collectors.toSet());
	}

	public int getMaxWidth() {
		return maxWidth;
	}
}

package assignment.game;

import assignment.actions.Move;
import assignment.entities.Box;
import assignment.entities.Empty;
import assignment.entities.Entity;
import assignment.entities.Player;

/**
 * A Sokoban game board.
 * GameBoard consists of information loaded from map data, such as
 * <li>Width and height of the game map</li>
 * <li>Walls in the map</li>
 * <li>Box destinations</li>
 * <li>Initial locations of boxes and player</li>
 * <p/>
 * GameBoard is capable to create many GameState instances, each representing an ongoing game.
 */
public class GameMap {

	private final Map<Position, Entity> map;

	private final int maxWidth;

	private final int maxHeight;

	private final Set<Position> destinations;

	private final int undoLimit;

	/**
	 * Create a new GameMap with width, height, set of box destinations and undo limit.
	 *
	 * @param maxWidth     Width of the game map.
	 * @param maxHeight    Height of the game map.
	 * @param destinations Set of box destination positions.
	 * @param undoLimit    Undo limit.
	 *                     Positive numbers specify the maximum number of undo actions.
	 *                     0 means undo is not allowed.
	 *                     -1 means unlimited. Other negative numbers are not allowed.
	 */
	public GameMap(int maxWidth, int maxHeight, Set<Position> destinations, int undoLimit) {
		this.maxWidth = maxWidth;
		this.maxHeight = maxHeight;
		this.destinations = Collections.unmodifiableSet(destinations);
		this.undoLimit = undoLimit;
		this.map = new HashMap<>();
	}

	private GameMap(Map<Position, Entity> map, Set<Position> destinations, int undoLimit) {
		this.map = Collections.unmodifiableMap(map);
		this.destinations = Collections.unmodifiableSet(destinations);
		this.undoLimit = undoLimit;
		this.maxWidth = map.keySet().stream().mapToInt(Position::x).max().orElse(0) + 1;
		this.maxHeight = map.keySet().stream().mapToInt(Position::y).max().orElse(0) + 1;
	}

	/**
	 * Get the maximum height of the game map.
	 *
	 * @return maximum height.
	 */
	public int getMaxHeight() {
		return this.maxHeight;
	}

	// Other methods omitted for brevity
}

Response Text:---
The method `fetchAction()` should read the user's input, interpret it, and return the corresponding `Action` object. It handles commands like move directions (WASD), undo (U/u), exit (R/r), and invalid inputs.

Here's a complete implementation:

```java
@Override
public Action fetchAction() {
    final String inputLine = terminalScanner.nextLine().trim();

    if (inputLine.isEmpty()) {
        return new InvalidInput();
    }

    // Check for exit command
    if (inputLine.equalsIgnoreCase(EXIT_COMMAND_TEXT)) {
        return new Exit();
    }

    // Check for undo command
    if (inputLine.equalsIgnoreCase("U")) {
        return new Undo();
    }

    // Check for move commands
    Matcher matcher = MOVE_REGEX.matcher(inputLine);
    if (matcher.matches()) {
        String actionChar = matcher.group("action").toLowerCase();
        switch (actionChar) {
            case "w":
                return new Move(Direction.UP);
            case "a":
                return new Move(Direction.LEFT);
            case "s":
                return new Move(Direction.DOWN);
            case "d":
                return new Move(Direction.RIGHT);
            case "h":
                return new Move(Direction.LEFT); // Assuming 'H' is left
            case "j":
                return new Move(Direction.DOWN); // Assuming 'J' is down
            case "k":
                return new Move(Direction.UP);   // Assuming 'K' is up
            case "l":
                return new Move(Direction.RIGHT); // Assuming 'L' is right
            default:
                return new InvalidInput();
        }
    }

    // If input doesn't match any command
    return new InvalidInput();
}
```

**Note:** This implementation assumes that the `Move` class takes a `Direction` enum, which should be defined elsewhere in your codebase, with values like `UP`, `DOWN`, `LEFT`, and `RIGHT`. Adjust the directions accordingly if your `Move` class uses different parameters.

        return new Undo(0);
    }

    // Check for move commands

    if (matcher.matches()) {
        String actionChar = matcher.group("action").toLowerCase();
        switch (actionChar) {
            case "w":
                return new Move(Direction.UP);
            case "a":
                return new Move(Direction.LEFT);
            case "s":
                return new Move(Direction.DOWN);
            case "d":
                return new Move(Direction.RIGHT);
            case "h":

            case "j":
                return new Move(Direction.DOWN);
            case "k":
                return new Move(Direction.UP);
            case "l":

            default:
                return new InvalidInput(1, "Invalid move command");
        }
    }

    // If input doesn't match any command
    return new InvalidInput(2, "Unrecognized command");
}

package assignment.tui;

import java.io.PrintStream;

/**
 * A rendering engine that prints to the terminal.
 */
public class TerminalRenderingEngine implements RenderingEngine {

	private final PrintStream outputStream;

	/**
	 * @param outputStream The {@link PrintStream} to write the output to.
	 */
	public TerminalRenderingEngine(PrintStream outputStream) {
		this.outputStream = outputStream;
	}

	@Override
	public void render(@NotNull GameState state) {
		final StringBuilder builder = new StringBuilder();
		for (int y = 0; y < state.getMapMaxHeight(); y++) {
			for (int x = 0; x < state.getMapMaxWidth(); x++) {
				final Entity entity = state.getEntity(Position.of(x, y));
				char charToPrint = ' ';
				if (entity instanceof Wall) {
					charToPrint = '#';
				}
				if (entity instanceof Box box) {
					charToPrint = (char) (box.getPlayerId() + 'a');
				}
				if (entity instanceof Player player) {
					charToPrint = (char) (player.getId() + 'A');
				}
				if (entity instanceof Empty) {
					charToPrint = state.getDestinations().contains(new Position(x, y)) ? '@' : '.';
				}
				builder.append(charToPrint);
			}
			builder.append('\n');
		}
		outputStream.print(builder);
	}

	@Override
	public void message(String content) {

Response Text:---
The `run` method should implement the main game loop for the terminal Sokoban game. Typically, this involves rendering the current game state, processing user input, executing actions based on the input, updating the game state, and repeating until the game ends (e.g., all boxes are placed correctly or the user quits).

Here's a complete implementation of the `run` method:

```java
@Override
public void run() {
    boolean gameRunning = true;
    while (gameRunning) {
        // Render the current game state
        renderingEngine.render(getGameState());

        // Get user input
        String input = inputEngine.readInput();

        // Process input into an action
        Action action = parseInputToAction(input);
        if (action == null) {
            // Invalid input, continue to next iteration
            continue;
        }

        // Execute the action
        ActionResult result = action.execute(getGameState());

        // Check if the game has been won or should exit
        if (result.isGameOver()) {
            renderingEngine.render(getGameState());
            System.out.println("Game Over! " + result.getMessage());
            gameRunning = false;
        }
    }
}
```

Note: This implementation assumes the existence of methods like `parseInputToAction(String input)` which converts user input into an `Action`, and that `renderingEngine.render()` and `getGameState()` are properly defined in the superclass or elsewhere. Adjustments may be needed based on the actual codebase.
